data.description:
Business Development Lead (German-speaking)
Full-time (40 hours per week), On-site (Berlin, Germany)

 

About Us
At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

 

About the Company
You'll be joining a fast-scaling, founder-led B2B company. With a proven track record, real clients, and a growing international presence across Europe, the business is at an exciting inflection point — systematising operations through smart processes, technology, and AI to become a European market leader.

 

The Role
As Commercial Growth Lead you will own the commercial engine — from inbound and outbound sales to aftersales, CRM governance, and customer retention. This is a high-ownership role for someone ready to make meaningful progress from day one: building structure where it's needed, optimising what already works, and leading a growing team of sales consultants towards ambitious targets. The company moves fast and expects you to move with it.

You'll work directly with the founders — shaping commercial strategy and executing with real discipline. This role isn't for someone waiting to be told what to do. It's for someone who spots what needs fixing, fixes it, and tracks the results. If you want to grow fast and have the company invest in your growth, this is the environment for it.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Grow and develop the inbound sales team, outbound function, aftersales, and offline conversion channels

  • Own sales targets and metrics — build structured plans and hold the team accountable to results

  • Drive customer satisfaction and retention across key brand clients

  • Oversee the CRM system and ensure the full customer journey is tracked, managed, and optimised

  • Develop deep market and customer understanding to inform pricing, product, and commercial strategy

  • Manage client relationships professionally, including escalations and disputes

  • Identify and implement AI-native workflow improvements that increase team efficiency and output

  • Report performance clearly to founders and use data to drive commercial decisions

     

Ideal Candidate

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in sales, with demonstrated experience leading or developing a team

  • Based in Berlin or genuinely willing to relocate — this is a full-time on-site role

  • Native-level German speaker — this is a non-negotiable requirement

  • Professional working English, written and verbal

  • Strong sense of ownership — you hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes, not just activities

  • Confident with CRM systems, pipeline management, and data-driven decision-making

  • Genuinely excited about AI-native tools and workflow automation — not just aware of them, actually using them

  • Ready to deliver visible commercial impact within the first 90 days

     

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a B2B environment with complex client relationships

  • Background in a founder-led or high-growth company where structure was being built, not inherited

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted sales workflows or CRM automation tools

     

Tools & Stack
CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce), AI workflow tools, Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

data.description:
Account Executive (m/f/x) (French Speaking) 

Location: EU 

(Remote) 

Comp: 120k EUR base 

Territories: France / Benelux / Southern Europe 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Account Executives who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Own and grow a defined territory of named enterprise accounts across France / Benelux / Southern Europe. 

  • Take commercial ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new opportunities through to negotiation, closing and account expansion. 

  • Deliver an individual annual revenue target of €1.1M once ramped, driving new business acquisition and growth within existing accounts. 

  • Build and develop a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, supported by SDRs and strategic partners. 

  • Lead complex enterprise sales engagements, typically involving deal values of €150K–€300K, multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles. 

  • Develop strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners and consulting firms to drive commercial opportunities. 

  • Position and sell complex, data-driven SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations, translating technical capabilities into measurable business value. 

  • Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities. 


  • Excellent proficiency in French verbal and written skills. 

  • Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values. 

  • Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion. 

  • Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects. 

  • Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations. 

  • Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features. 

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments. 

  • Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals. 

  • Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders. 

  • Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks. 

  • Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue. 

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions. 

  • Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity. 

  • Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers. 

  • Nice to have: experience selling services. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

  

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

data.title: Enterprise Account Executive - UKI/Nordics (m/f/x)

data.description:
ChurchDesk ist die All-in-One-Plattform für die digitale Arbeit von Kirchen. Unsere Vision: Kirchen die Freiheit zu geben, sich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren – auf Menschen und Gemeinschaft statt auf Verwaltung. Dafür bündeln wir in einer Lösung, die speziell für kirchliche Strukturen entwickelt wurde, alles, was Kirchen in ganz Europa für ihre tägliche Arbeit brauchen: von CRM, Mitgliederverwaltung und Kalender über Spendenmanagement und Website-Verwaltung bis hin zu einer eigenen Social App und mehr als zehn weiteren Modulen.

Mit Büros in Berlin, Kopenhagen, Oslo und Groningen sind wir ein internationales Team, das Technologie und gesellschaftliche Wirkung verbindet. Bereits über 10.000 Kirchengemeinden in Europa vertrauen auf ChurchDesk.

Warum Du Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte werden solltest?

Kirchen stehen mitten in einem tiefgreifenden Wandel – und immer mehr große kirchliche Organisationen setzen dabei auf ChurchDesk. Unser Enterprise-Geschäft im DACH-Raum steht auf einem starken Fundament. Als Enterprise Account Executive sorgst Du dafür, dass es weiter wächst: Du überzeugst (Erz-)Bistümer, Diözesen, Landeskirchen und kirchliche Verbände von ChurchDesk und führst sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zur Unterschrift. Eine Rolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, echter Verantwortung und einer Wirkung, die weit über Zahlen hinausgeht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du gewinnst neue Enterprise-Kunden im DACH-Raum durch gezielte Outbound-Aktivitäten, die Bearbeitung von Inbound-Leads und den Aufbau eines starken Netzwerks in der kirchlichen Landschaft.

  • Du führst komplexe Sales-Zyklen eigenständig – von Prospecting und Bedarfsanalyse über Präsentationen bis hin zu Verhandlung und Abschluss.

  • Du verstehst die Strukturen und Herausforderungen großer kirchlicher Organisationen und entwickelst passgenaue Lösungen, die echten Mehrwert schaffen.

  • Du navigierst souverän durch Organisationen mit vielen Beteiligten – von Leitungsebenen über Fachabteilungen bis zu Gremien.

  • Du pflegst eine gesunde Pipeline, erstellst verlässliche Forecasts und übernimmst Verantwortung für Dein eigenes Umsatzziel.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Success, Produkt und Marketing zusammen und sorgst für eine reibungslose Übergabe neuer Kunden.

  • Du vertrittst ChurchDesk professionell bei Kundenterminen vor Ort, auf Fachkonferenzen und gegenüber hochrangigen kirchlichen Entscheidungsträgern.


  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise als Account Executive mit Fokus auf Enterprise-Kunden im SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Du hast bereits erfolgreich Neukunden gewonnen und weißt, wie man auch in längeren, komplexen Sales-Zyklen ans Ziel kommt.

  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb an stakeholder-getriebene Organisationen, idealerweise im kirchlichen, NGO- oder öffentlichen Umfeld.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Präsentations- und Verhandlungskompetenz – auch auf Führungs- und Leitungsebene.

  • Du fühlst Dich in HubSpot zu Hause und nutzt es, um Deine Pipeline strukturiert im Blick zu behalten.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Reisebereitschaft innerhalb des DACH-Raums.

  • Eine proaktive, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und Interesse an der Mission von ChurchDesk und der Rolle der Kirche in einer sich wandelnden Gesellschaft.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Eine Rolle in einem wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen, in der du echte Verantwortung übernimmst, deine Arbeit aktiv mitgestaltest und dabei viel dazulernst.

  • Wachse mit uns: Ein dedizierter Sales Coach an deiner Seite sowie die Möglichkeit, dich durch Kurse und Webinare technisch und im Pre-Sales stetig weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Zukunft im Blick – Wir bezuschussen deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 %, damit du heute gut arbeitest und morgen gut abgesichert bist.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub – weil ausreichend Erholung wichtig ist.

  • 37 Stunden Arbeitswoche – mehr Balance, mehr Zeit für dich.

  • Eine offene und ehrliche Feedbackkultur – gemeinsam wachsen, voneinander lernen, transparent kommunizieren.

  • Ein wunderschönes, modernes Altbau-Office im Herzen Neukölln – zentral, lebendig und perfekt angebunden. 

  • Lust auf einen Tapetenwechsel? Besuche uns in Kopenhagen, Oslo oder Groningen! Wir übernehmen deine Reise- und Spesenkosten.

  • Unvergessliche Team-Erlebnisse – von Company Events bis zu gemeinsamen Reisen nach Kroatien & Prag.

Über ChurchDesk

Bei ChurchDesk sind wir der Meinung, dass die Kirche eine wichtige Rolle in der Gesellschaft spielt. Unsere Plattform wird von Tausenden von Gemeinden genutzt, um ihre Arbeit zu organisieren, die Kommunikation mit Mitgliedern zu verbessern, mehr Menschen zu erreichen und neue Möglichkeiten der Mittelbeschaffung zu erschließen.
Unsere Kunden sind Teil einer der größten und ältesten Institutionen der Welt: der Kirche. Sie befindet sich in einem erheblichen Wandel, um sich auf die Zukunft vorzubereiten – und wir sind hier, um diese Transformation zu unterstützen. Für Kirchen in ganz Europa ist es entscheidend, effizienter zu arbeiten und mit ihren Mitgliedern und Gemeinden in Verbindung zu bleiben.

ChurchDesk gibt es seit mehr als 15 Jahren – von einem Startup zu einem internationalen Unternehmen, das Kunden in ganz Europa bedient. Und wir fangen gerade erst an!

Wir leben unsere Werte aktiv in unserer täglichen Arbeit:

#challenge: Wir fordern uns selbst – und unsere Kunden – kontinuierlich heraus, uns zu verbessern. Wir arbeiten wie ein professionelles Sportteam: mit Ehrgeiz, Disziplin und starkem Teamgeist.

#dogoodbusiness: Gutes Geschäft zu machen ist ein Marathon, kein Sprint. Es erfordert Ausdauer, Qualität und Integrität – jeden einzelnen Tag.

#jointheride: Die Reise ist genauso wichtig wie das Ziel. Seien Sie ein Teil davon, feiern Sie Erfolge – und haben Sie Spaß! Wir schätzen es, zusammen zu sein, besonders im Büro.

At Machine Learning Reply, we work with our customers on cutting-edge projects for which we are looking for DevOps and ML Engineers to support our customer projects around machine learning and data processing across various industries. To expand our team, we are looking for a talented and highly skilled consultant with a technical background to join our team. As a consultant, you will be responsible for providing expert advice and technical support to our clients.

If you're a DevOps or ML Engineer or just starting out in the field of machine learning and/or DevOps engineering - if you never lose focus, love coding, data and AI, and are passionate about bringing your ideas to life - then we want to hear from you!


Responsibilities:

  • Design innovative, technical approaches for data intensive and applications with a focus on machine learning and artificial intelligence.

  • Implement and take ownership for your solutions on in either cloud based (AWS, Azure or GCP) and/or on-premises infrastructures of our customers.

  • Automate recurring tasks by state-of-the-art DevOps and MLOps concepts, enabling your customers to significantly reduce their time-to-delivery.

  • Take care of the necessary monitoring, failover, and recovery infrastructures that allow our customers save operation of their machine learning solutions in agreement with latest regulatory requirements

  • Closely interact with customers and stakeholders to translate concrete and complex business requirements into production-ready solutions

  • Collaborate with various disciplines such as enterprise architects, analysts, data scientists or data engineers to develop data-intensive applications such as data warehouses, data lakes and/or data platforms


What we offer you:

  • Access to work on projects across industries (large and mid-market companies in Banking, Insurance, Automotive, Retail, etc.)

  • Broaden your skills through interdisciplinary work and training in the areas of data engineering, cloud architecture, and data science

  • Benefit from industry-leading cooperations in the cloud, BI, and AutoML field

  • Very active social program - including training, conferences, team buildings, Reply Exchange, communities of practices, and hackathons

  • Work in an open, flat environment, within a broad Reply knowledge-sharing network

  • Award-winning office space in downtown Munich with access to “Stammstrecke”

  • You choose your state-of-the-art equipment

  • Public transport ticket with Deutschlandticket

  • Gym-membership subsidy for a gym of your choice

  • Flexible work environment between client, Reply office, and remote work


Minimum Job Requirements / Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s / master’s degree in computer science or any other related fileds (e.g. engineering, statistics, physics).

  • First practical experience with DevOps/MLOps principals and computing platforms like Microsoft Azure, AWS and GCP as well as Databricks.

  • Ability to convincingly communicate and present analytical results to management.

  • We cover the full lifecycle of Data, from Cloud Infrastructure, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and Visualization to ML Engineering to and MLOps. Interest and/or experience in some of those fields is an advantage.

  • Fluent in English and German.


Desired:

  • Working experience in cloud technologies (AWS, Azure or GCP), Kubernetes and programming languages like Python, Java and Scala.

  • Practical experience with SQL and NoSQL database technologies and data lakes

  • Experience with big data technologies (Apache Spark), data streaming (Apache Kafka) and workflow orchestration (Apache Airflow, Dagster)

data.description:
SumUp builds simple, affordable financial tools that help small businesses get paid, manage their money, and grow. Beyond payments, we offer a number of financial products - including business banking, card products, lending, and invoicing — giving merchants everything they need to manage their payments and finances in one place.

The Cards squad owns the systems that power card issuing, and transaction processing for merchants across Europe, handling millions of transactions every day. We're scaling these systems to support new product capabilities and lay the foundations for a more global, resilient platform, and we're looking for a senior backend engineer who can take real ownership of this complex, high-throughput work while raising the technical bar for the rest of the squad.

It's a chance to shape distributed systems architecture at scale, mentor engineers around you, and build infrastructure that genuinely matters to small businesses.

🎥 Join us in our Sofia Team - get a feel for our Sofia office here.

What you'll do

  • Own and drive the end-to-end delivery of backend services within the Cards EU domain, including observability, testing, and production support
  • Lead architectural discussions and shape the technical roadmap by proposing solutions for complex, distributed systems challenges
  • Partner with engineers in adjacent squads and the product manager to shape and refine the squad backlog
  • Mentor engineers through code and design reviews, pragmatic technical trade offs, and knowledge sharing that raises the team's engineering standards
  • Participate in incident reviews and the on-call rotation, taking accountability for the reliability of the services the team builds
  • Apply and champion AI tooling to accelerate engineering workflows, and help raise the team's overall AI literacy

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Proven track record delivering production-ready backend services end to end, including testing, monitoring, and incident response, on a modern cloud-native stack.
  • Production experience with Kotlin and genuine curiosity about picking up additional languages such as Golang.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, API design, data modelling, and working with relational databases

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum and Northzone), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

Distribusion is quickly expanding globally and looking for a (Senior) Technical Partnerships Manager to join the Corporate Travel Partnerships team to drive the strategic growth and performance of some of our key partnerships in the business travel space. This role will require you to wear many hats and certainly not leave you bored!

What you will do:

  • Support Pre-Sales: Act as a technical expert during initial engagements to evaluate partner needs and demonstrate our capabilities.

  • Consult on API Implementation: Guide partners through their API integration, ensuring a seamless process that meets certification standards.

  • Translate Requirements: Gather technical requirements directly from external partners and break them down into actionable specs for internal teams.

  • Manage Custom Projects: Drive the end-to-end delivery of custom developments, managing timelines, stakeholders, and go-live execution

  • Guide Product Development: Leverage partner feedback and insights to shape the ongoing development of our core API and integration tools.

  • Manage Technical Relationships: Own the long-term technical relationship with partners to drive collaboration, product engagement, and brand stickiness.

Workplace: We are mainly looking for this role based in Germany, preferably at our headquarters in Berlin.
We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.


Who you are:

  • 5 + years of work experience in a tech company (experience in a technology/software company, travel agency, transportation, and logistics industry is an advantage but not a must). 

  • You have had deep exposure to API integrations, and you are confident in navigating documentation, sprint cycles, and system architecture, even if you’re not the one coding.

  • A big plus if you have experience in the corporate travel space (any vertical).

  • You’re a structured communicator who can translate complexity into clarity for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You take ownership, thrive in ambiguity, and are energised by solving cross-functional coordination challenges.

  • You’re fluent in English, both written and spoken. Other languages are a plus.

  • You’re open to business travel, as needed.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry.

  • You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company.

  • We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.

  • You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company.


Our hiring process for this role:

Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Masha Marynova, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Sara Fahrenhorst.
For any queries, please reach out to your Talent Partner at ().


Do you want to work in an advanced tech environment and have an impact on millions of travellers around the globe? Come join us!

We are building the first AI-native platform for automated product compliance in MedTech. REMATIQ turn hundreds of page of complex regulations (like MDR and FDA guidance) into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers’ development and quality processes. The result: life‑saving medical devices reach patients faster and safer.

About the job

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you build software with and for our customers. Existing customers ask for more than the standard product does. They want further use cases, integrations with their own systems and workflows specific to their organisation. You sit with the customer's team, scope the problem and build the solution end to end. It runs at the customer as custom software or becomes a feature of the REMATIQ web app.

This is a software engineering role with customer contact, not a consulting role. You work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product and the platform team.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

How you'll contribute

  • Scope with the customer: Sit with their project team and subject-matter experts, understand the workflow and its constraints, and cut the problem into something that can ship in weeks.

  • Build and ship end to end: Design, develop and deploy the solution, including backend services, integrations, AI workflows and the interface it needs.

  • Run what you shipped: Operate it in production, fix what breaks, and be the customer's technical contact for it.

  • Build integrations: Connect REMATIQ to the systems customers already use in their development and quality processes.

  • Move custom work into the product: Build features in the web app and work with the platform team to turn one customer's solution into a product capability.

  • Find the next use case: Spot further use cases while you work with the customer and scope them together with Delivery.

Our stack

We work in a modern TypeScript‑first monorepo:

  • Core: Node.js 20+, TypeScript 5+, pnpm workspaces, Turborepo.

  • Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, and design system.

  • Backend & workflows: Express-based services, with DBOS for durable workflows.

  • Data & storage: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Prisma ORM, Azure Blob Storage.

  • AI & observability: Azure OpenAI, Langfuse, Sentry, plus logging/tracing with tools like Winston and OpenTelemetry.

  • Dev experience: AI‑assisted workflows with Cursor and Claude Code, integrated into our TypeScript‑first monorepo and review process.

What you'll bring

We are looking for a software engineer who ships production software and is equally at home in a customer's meeting room.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Relevant background: 3+ years as a software engineer shipping production software, ideally including forward deployed, solutions engineering or other customer-facing engineering work.

  • Product management or team lead experience: Some experience as a product manager or team lead, where you owned scope, priorities and requirements for what is being built, is a strong plus.

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js backend experience: You build and operate production services and can contribute to React frontends where needed.

  • Solid database fundamentals: PostgreSQL (ideally), including data modelling, migrations and performance.

  • Integration experience: You have connected a product to enterprise systems through APIs, SSO or data exchange, and have worked within a customer's IT and security constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs: You have put LLM-driven features into production and know how to make them predictable and reviewable.

  • Strong customer presence: You scope a problem with non-technical stakeholders, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and manage expectations without a project manager next to you.

  • AI-native working style: You use Claude Code or Cursor every day to move faster without compromising reliability.

  • High ownership: You take an ambiguous customer problem to production with limited guidance.

  • Willingness to travel: You work on site at customers when the project needs it.

  • Fluency in English (mandatory). German is a strong plus.

We'll be especially excited if you

  • Have worked as a forward deployed or customer-embedded engineer

  • Have built software for a regulated industry such as MedTech or pharma.

  • Have been a founder or a very early engineer at a startup.

    Why this is a great opportunity

  • Impact in a high-stakes domain – Work on compliance workflows in one of the most regulated industries, where correctness and traceability matter and the outcomes are real.

  • Bring GenAI into production – Build the systems that make LLM-driven features predictable, auditable, and reliable in safety-critical MedTech environments.

  • Real ownership – Own major parts of our platform and drive architectural decisions across backend services, workflows, and data.

  • AI‑agent‑first development – Build in an environment where tools like Cursor and Claude Code are first‑class citizens, helping you explore designs, refactor, and ship faster while you stay in control of quality and reliability.

  • Strong peers – Work with people who care deeply about craft and outcomes, in a high-ownership culture that includes teammates with founder experience.

About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As an Implementation Specialist at Hawk, your responsibility is to transform customer requirements into a functioning solution that helps them achieve their business objectives around transaction monitoring, customer screening and fraud detection, alongside cutting-edge AI technologies. You start with a signed contract and support the customer until go-live. This includes translating policies, regulatory obligations and risk factors into Hawk's setup, data mapping, workflow configuration, UAT support and ensuring that key project timelines and milestones are met. You support our customers in realising true value by detecting more financial crime, allowing investigators to focus on what matters instead of drowning in false positives, and adopting state-of-the-art AI technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Requirements and needs assessment: gather and analyse the customer's AML, fraud and screening requirements and advise on best-practice configuration.

  • Configuration: translate policies, screening algorithms, regulatory requirements and risk factors into Hawk's setup, covering rules, screening, customer risk rating and workflows.

  • Data mapping and integration: lead the technical deployment and integration with the customer's systems, via API or batch mechanisms.

  • Testing and go-live: support the customer through testing, UAT and sign-off, troubleshoot issues, and support a successful transition to a production environment.

  • Training and enablement: deliver training to the customer's teams from a functional as well as technical standpoint.

  • Project management: plan and run the implementation from signature to go-live on time and within scope, with documentation and regular stakeholder updates, combining hands-on work with project leadership.

  • Primary contact: be the first point of contact for implementation questions and issues.

  • Collaboration and feedback: work closely with Customer Value Partners for a smooth implementation, and bring actionable customer feedback and gaps to Product, Development and Hawk's GTM organisation.

  • Document every configuration decision and the reasoning behind it, so the setup holds up when the customer's auditor or regulator asks why a rule was set the way it was.

  • Manage each implementation task and the implementation success as an outcome you own, as directed by our Customer Value Partner, resulting in activity completion and a go-live on the dates you committed to.

Your Profile

  • 6+ years in implementation consulting or solution consulting, with at least 3 of those years hands-on implementing AML, fraud or screening solutions.

  • Subject matter expertise in AML and compliance. You are familiar with key typologies and patterns, the regulatory expectations behind them, and how monitoring programmes as well as AI get examined.

  • You can confidently stand in front of an MLRO and discuss and defend a rule set. This is a must-have, not a nice-to-have.

  • Hands-on data skills: SQL, APIs, CSV and JSON, and data modelling. You're familiar with standardised payment message formats, including SWIFT MT and ISO 20022, SEPA and card data.

  • Integration literacy. You don't write production code, but you're at home with APIs, JSON payloads, SFTP configurations as well as SSO.

  • Proven track record of taking complex implementations to go-live on time, ideally several in parallel, with banking customers or other financial institutions.

  • Stakeholder alignment. You ensure that internal and external parties both have the information they need, keep them aligned and manage expectations.

  • Able to explain complexity simply. Imagine data models for compliance leads, fraud typologies for data engineers. You do it clearly in writing and in the room, in fluent English.

  • A degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus

  • Business-fluent German, for working with our DACH customers.

  • CAMS (or equivalent) certification, or time spent in a second-line compliance or MLRO team.

  • Builds constructive relationships with customers and stays calm and under pressure Builder mentality: works independently and brings structure to ambiguity where no established process exists, taking the initiative to define one.

  • Is a resourceful problem-solver who investigates unknowns and tests system behaviour. Knows when and whom to escalate.

  • Manages expectations proactively. Flags timeline and scope risks early, quantifies them, offers phased options and aligns Sales and Customer Success.

  • Handles product gaps transparently. Clarifies the underlying (regulatory) requirement, offers workarounds with their trade-offs, feeds back to Product and doesn't commit to unconfirmed dates .

  • You use AI tools such as Claude in your daily workflow to speed up mapping, documentation and analysis, and you have opinions about where they help and where they don't.

data.description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

About the role

Berlitz is rebuilding its commercial and financial platform. That includes a new CRM, usage-based billing, modern payment processing, and a consolidated ERP, all supporting new digital products for learners, teachers, and enterprise customers.

We're looking for a Senior Financial Systems Engineer to own the flow of money through that platform, from quote and checkout through billing and payment to the general ledger. You'll be the technical authority on how our systems exchange financial data. You'll make sure every customer, invoice, payment, refund, and credit reconciles cleanly at month-end.

This is a hands-on engineering role that sits at the intersection of engineering and finance. You'll report into Engineering and work day to day with Finance, RevOps, and our external NetSuite implementation partner.

What you'll do

  • Own the architecture and data contracts for our order-to-cash flow across HubSpot, Stripe, Adyen, Metronome, and NetSuite.

  • Build and maintain integrations using NetSuite SuiteScript and REST/SuiteTalk, PSP APIs and webhooks, and our iPaaS (Workato), choosing custom code or low-code where each makes sense.

  • Design reconciliation between payment processors, billing, bank settlements, and the ledger, and build the jobs, alerts, and audit trails that keep it reliable.

  • Model prepaid credit packages and usage-based consumption correctly, including deferred revenue, drawdown, expiry, refunds, and credit notes.

  • Support multi-entity, multi-currency operations, including subsidiaries, intercompany flows, FX, and tax handling.

  • Act as the technical counterpart to our NetSuite implementation partner: review designs, challenge assumptions, and take ownership of what they build.

  • Partner with Finance to shorten and de-risk month-end close by removing manual work and fixing data quality at the source.

  • Document the financial data model and integrations so the platform is supportable beyond you.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years building or owning financial, billing, or payments systems.

  • Hands-on NetSuite development experience (SuiteScript 2.x, REST/SuiteTalk, saved searches) and a solid understanding of its record model, including customers, sales orders, invoices, payments, deposits, and journals.

  • Production experience integrating Stripe and/or Adyen, including webhooks, idempotency, payouts and settlement reports, disputes, and fees.

  • Real accounting literacy. You can explain revenue recognition, deferred revenue, cash application, and bank reconciliation, and you know why they matter to Finance.

  • Strong integration engineering fundamentals: API design, event-driven patterns, retries and error handling, and data validation.

  • Comfort working across teams and translating between engineers, accountants, and commercial stakeholders.

  • Good judgement under deadline pressure, with the ability to ship pragmatically without creating reconciliation debt.

Nice to have

  • Experience with usage-based or consumption billing platforms (Metronome, Orb, Chargebee, or similar).

  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or other CRM-to-ERP integrations.

  • iPaaS experience (Workato, Boomi, Celigo, MuleSoft).

  • Experience migrating from a legacy billing or CRM system to a new stack.

  • Exposure to SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls around financial systems.

  • Experience at a multi-country business or in education / subscription services.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: You understand our current order-to-cash flows end to end. You've taken technical ownership of the payments-to-ledger integration and identified the biggest reconciliation risks.

  • First 6 months: New products bill, collect, and post to NetSuite correctly across entities and currencies. Month-end reconciliation between PSPs and the ledger is largely automated.

  • First year: Our financial systems are well documented, monitored, and trusted by Finance, and they're ready to scale to new products and markets.

Why Berlitz

  • A rare chance to shape a financial platform nearly from scratch at a global brand with a long history.

  • Direct impact on how the company operates and reports, with high visibility across Engineering, Finance, and leadership.

  • A team that values pragmatic engineering and cross-functional ownership.

At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow.

Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us.

data.description:
About us

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About the team

The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents.

Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services.

All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down.

The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on-call.

About you

You're a staff-level engineer who wants to own systems, not tickets. You've built high-traffic, low-latency Python services and carried the pager for them. You think in trade-offs: latency versus cost, flexibility versus a public API that customers can't afford to see break, the fix that ships this week versus the architecture that has to last two years. You can lead work that spans several engineers and several quarters, you enjoy mentoring others, and you're fine when a problem shows up half-defined. You don't mind being the one who reads the spec for some unfamiliar protocol, works out how it fits, and designs an integration that holds up at scale. You change your mind when someone has a better argument, you make the people around you better, and you still care about your code long after it merges.

What you will do

  • Own the technical direction of one or more of our services - architecture, performance, and reliability.

  • Lead design of new systems and public APIs, and the evolution of existing ones as traffic and feature scope grow.

  • Raise the engineering bar through design and code review, and mentor mid and senior engineers into owning bigger scopes.

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products!

We're looking for a Senior Web Analyst to own and evolve our digital measurement ecosystem. You'll help us understand how millions of users interact with our digital products and turn that understanding into better product and business decisions. You'll work at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Engineering, ensuring that our tracking is accurate, scalable and future-proof. From defining measurement strategies to implementing tracking solutions and uncovering actionable insights, you'll play a key role in improving our digital products and customer experience.

This is not a generic Data Analytics or Data Science role. We're looking for someone with a strong background in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics who enjoys solving real business problems through reliable data.

What You’ll Do

    Drive Measurement Strategy

    • Define KPIs and success metrics together with Product, Marketing and business stakeholders

    • Develop tracking specifications for new products, features and customer journeys

    Generate Insights

    • Analyse user behaviour, customer journeys and conversion funnels

    • Build dashboards and reporting solutions that enable data-informed decision making

    Collaborate Across Teams

    • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and Marketing teams

    • Present analytical findings in a clear and actionable way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

What You’ll Bring

  • Several years of experience in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics

Nice to Have

Deine Aufgaben:

Datenplattform & Architektur

  • Technische Herausforderungen identifizierst Du frühzeitig, entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungsansätze und optimierst bestehende Datenpipelines kontinuierlich.

Zusammenarbeit & Datenstrategie

  • Eng arbeitest Du mit unseren Analytics-, Product- und Engineering-Teams zusammen und unterstützt die Umsetzung datengetriebener Anforderungen.

  • Fachliche und technische Anforderungen übersetzt Du in skalierbare Datenlösungen und sorgst für eine transparente Abstimmung mit den relevanten Stakeholdern.

  • Die Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten Datenstrategie gestaltest Du aktiv mit und evaluierst neue Technologien und moderne Data-Engineering-Ansätze.

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Data Engineering oder in einer vergleichbaren technisch geprägten Rolle sowie fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Datenarchitekturen und Datenmodellierung bringst Du mit.

  • Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python und SQL sowie Erfahrung mit professionellen Engineering-Standards, automatisierten Tests und CI/CD-Prozessen zeichnen Dich aus.

data.description:
About the Team

The ClickPipes team builds the services that power data ingestion into ClickHouse Cloud. As a primary entry point for customers’ data, ClickPipes is critical to product adoption and the company’s growth. We work at petabyte scale, solving challenges in distributed systems, fault tolerance, and high-throughput ingestion. You’ll help make these pipelines performant, reliable, and easy to operate, with ownership of technical decisions and the platform as a whole.

You can find some of the team’s recent work highlighted in our blog:

  • GCP Pub/Sub connector for ClickPipes is now in Private Preview

  • Terraform & OpenAPI for ClickPipes is now Generally Available

  • Unordered mode for GCS ClickPipes is now available

We’re looking for backend engineers with experience in data-intensive systems who enjoy working across technologies. You’ll collaborate with engineering and product partners and drive projects from design through production.

What will you do?

  • Build and evolve integrations with streaming platforms and object storage, including Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage.

  • Continuously improve our systems based on operational metrics, customer feedback, and evolving business requirements.

  • Drive technical discussions and contribute to architectural decisions that impact our platform's scalability and resilience.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to ensure system reliability and respond to production incidents.

About you:

  • 5+ years of software development experience building and operating distributed systems.

  • Strong knowledge of Go and its ecosystem.

  • Experience designing systems for scalability and fault tolerance, with an understanding of concurrency, consistency, and failure recovery.

  • Understanding of cloud-native architecture and practical experience with at least one major cloud provider.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving production issues in distributed systems.

  • Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate across engineering and product teams.

  • Experience with data ingestion pipelines, streaming platforms, or object storage is a plus.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

  • TEAMSPIRIT & TEAMEVENTS: Freu dich auf eine kollegiale Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, jede Menge Spaß und großartigem Teamspirit sowie regelmäßige Teamevents wie gemeinsame Sportsessions, Grillabende oder einfach nur ein Feierabenddrink an deiner Station. 

  • AUSTAUSCHPROGRAMM: Tausche deinen Arbeitsplatz mit einem deiner europaweiten Kolleg:innen und arbeite bis zu vier Wochen im Jahr an den schönsten Orten Europas.

  • CAMPER BUDGET: Du bekommst eine jährliche Freimiete für unsere Camper, damit du den #happyroadsurfing Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst.

  • JOBRAD: Bleibe fit mit unserem Angebot eines Jobrads.

  • DISCOUNTS: Nutze unsere Corporate Benefits Plattform, die Travel Industry Card und Family & Friends Rabatte

Darum geht’s

Bei uns reparierst du nicht im Minutentakt Kundenautos. Du kümmerst dich um unsere eigene Campervan-Flotte und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen sicher in den Urlaub starten. Dabei bist du die technische Ansprechperson an unserer Station in Nürnberg/Regensburg.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du hältst unsere Campervans technisch fit und checkst, dass jedes Fahrzeug verkehrssicher auf die Straße geht

  • Kleinere Reparaturen und Wartungen machst du selbst

  • Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für das Stationsteam und zeigst ihm, wie einfache Reparaturen gehen

  • Ein paar Tage im Monat unterstützt du andere Stationen

  • Du bringst Ideen ein, wie wir Abläufe rund um die Fahrzeuge besser machen

Was du mitbringst

  • Eine Ausbildung im Kfz-Bereich oder handwerkliche bzw. technische Erfahrung, z. B. als Land- oder Baumaschinenmechaniker:in, Zweiradmechatroniker:in, Elektriker:in oder als leidenschaftliche:r Hobbyschrauber:in

  • Lust, Neues zu lernen. Was dir fehlt, bringen wir dir bei

  • Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig und packst mit an

  • Gutes Deutsch und Englisch

  • Führerschein Klasse B

Was wir dir bieten

  • 🕗 Montag bis Freitag, kein Wochenende. Die Arbeitszeit legst du flexibel zwischen 8 und 18 Uhr, 40 Std./Woche

  • 🚐 Fahrten zu anderen Stationen an ein paar Tagen im Monat

  • 🤝 Ein junges, hilfsbereites Team und kurze Wege

So läuft deine Bewerbung

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht, dein Lebenslauf reicht. Danach machen wir einen kurzen Call, dann lernst du uns vor Ort an der Station kennen und im Anschluss möchten wir dich gerne nochmal in einem Online-Interview besser kennenlernen. Danach gibt’s schnell eine Rückmeldung.

Dein Gehalt
Wir ❤️ Transparenz. Das Gehaltsband für diese Position liegt zwischen 40.000 EUR und 48.000 EUR brutto jährlich. Wir führen aktuell Gehaltsbänder in unseren Stellenbeschreibungen ein, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Sobald wir uns im Bewerbungsprozess besser kennenlernen und deine Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen noch genauer einschätzen können, finden wir gemeinsam heraus, welche Stufe innerhalb des Gehaltsbands am besten zu dir passt. In einem jährlichen Feedbackgespräch wird dein Gehalt mindestens einmal im Jahr überprüft.

Du bist für die Aufgabe wie gemacht? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Für Rückfragen kannst Du dich auch gern jederzeit an

ABOUT #ROADSURFER

roadsurfer was founded in Munich in 2016 by five friends who wanted to make campervan travel easier. What started with 25 VW California vans has grown into the global leader in campervan and motorhome adventures, with 10,000+ vehicles at around 100 stations across Europe and North America. Travellers can rent, subscribe to or buy a campervan and hit the road their way. Behind it all are 1,000+ people in our offices and stations, working together towards one goal: creating unforgettable outdoor memories. Built on a culture of trust, openness and ownership, roadsurfer gives you room to grow and see the difference you make every day. Ready to ride the wave with us?

data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

About the Role

The Exploration Company builds the TEC vehicle family and is preparing the next generation of vehicles and products. As a Senior Avionics Engineer in the Future Systems team, you will be the system engineer who turns future mission concepts into credible, well-defined avionics, communications and power architectures. You will bring a solid working expertise in electrical power systems, data handling and communications, and you will shape designs that are ready to be challenged, tested and flown.

You will work closely with the other engineering disciplines, and you will report to the Principal Engineer of the project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own work packages or full future projects in avionics, communications and power, from concept through verification, delivering on time, on quality and on cost.

  • Define functional breakdowns and high-level requirements, flow them down to avionics subsystems, and manage the associated technical baselines so the design meets the needs of each project.

  • Develop system architectures and conceptual designs, perform avionics-related technical trade-offs, and carry out budget and performance analyses (power, mass, data, thermal interfaces).

  • Write development, implementation, verification and validation plans, and drive them through to completion with the teams involved.

  • Develop hardware solutions for future projects, from requirements to integration and test support.

What we would love to see from you

In this role, ideally, you will have the following:

  • Proven hands-on experience in designing electrical systems for spacecraft or other aerospace platforms, with a clear record of delivering them.

  • A broad understanding of the full functional chain of space-based avionics, communications and power systems, and how the pieces interact.

  • Able to work effectively with neighboring subsystems (thermal, GNC, propulsion, flight software, operations), understanding their interfaces and constraints well enough to resolve cross-disciplinary trade-offs and keep interface control documents aligned.

  • Strong systems engineering skills: defining requirements and their flow-down, managing technical baselines, and producing architectures and trade-offs.

  • Experience with budgets and performance analysis (power, mass, data, thermal) to support design decisions.

  • Hands-on experience with development, assembly, integration and testing of electrical units for space applications.

  • Strong written and oral communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to engineers, managers and partners.

  • A degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Aerospace Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in the relevant domain.

As a guideline, candidates typically bring 5+ years of relevant experience in aerospace system design. We value demonstrated capability over the number of years, so we welcome applications from candidates with a strong track record who may have followed a non-linear path.

Skills and Behaviours

  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to structure complex problems and reach sound decisions.

  • Organised and pragmatic, able to set priorities across several work packages.

  • Positive and flexible, with a can-do attitude to get the job done.

  • Collaborative, communicating at all levels of the business and working across disciplines.

  • Feedback ready, willing to give proactive and mindful feedback across all levels of the company.

  • Highly motivated, to work in a fast-paced, autonomously driven and demanding start-up environment.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

As a Senior Navigation Sensors engineer, you will support the integration and testing of the Nyx navigation sensors – Inertial measurement Unit (IMU), GNSS Receiver, Star Tracker and LiDAR – ensuring seamless integration and performance of the Navigation Sensing Suite (NSS) functional chain.

Key Responsibilities

Navigation Sensor Systems Development

  • Take technical ownership of the spacecraft's navigation sensor suite, including requirements definition, architecture, component selection, and system-level performance.

  • Define and maintain sensor requirements, specifications, and interfaces in alignment with overall spacecraft mission and system requirements.

  • Assess sensor technologies, evaluate design trade-offs, and drive technical decisions to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and suitability for the mission.

  • Ensure proper integration of navigation sensors into the spacecraft avionics architecture.

Supplier and Component Management

  • Act as the technical focal point for navigation sensor suppliers throughout the component development lifecycle.

  • Coordinate technical reviews, manage supplier deliverables, and resolve technical issues throughout development and procurement.

Testing, Verification and Certification

  • Develop and maintain verification and qualification strategies for navigation sensor components and systems.

  • Define and review test plans, procedures, and acceptance criteria.

  • Coordinate and support component-level testing, environmental qualification, functional verification, and system integration testing.

  • Analyze test results, assess compliance with requirements, and drive resolution of identified anomalies.

  • Prepare and maintain verification evidence and technical documentation to support qualification, certification, and mission readiness.

  • Support reviews and technical interactions with customers, external stakeholders, and certification authorities.

GNC and Cross-Functional Integration

  • Work closely with the GNC team to define navigation sensor performance requirements and ensure alignment with spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control needs.

  • Collaborate on sensor selection, performance modeling, and system-level performance assessments.

  • Support the development and validation of sensor models and their integration into GNC algorithms and simulations.

  • Coordinate with other spacecraft engineering disciplines to ensure consistent interfaces and successful end-to-end system integration.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of experience in avionics, spacecraft systems, navigation sensors, or aerospace systems engineering.

  • Experience developing, integrating, and verifying aerospace sensor systems.

  • Experience working with external suppliers on complex aerospace components.

  • Strong understanding of requirements engineering, system integration, verification, and qualification processes.

  • Experience defining and executing component-level and system-level test campaigns.

  • Ability to analyze technical data, evaluate sensor performance, and drive resolution of complex engineering problems.

  • Experience working in multidisciplinary engineering environments and coordinating technical activities across teams.

  • Good level of understanding of the following domains:

    • Navigation, Guidance and Control

    • Navigation sensors

    • Hardware testing

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with simulation and software development tools (e.g. Python, Github, C/C++).

  • Experience with spacecraft navigation sensors such as GNSS receivers, inertial measurement units (IMUs), accelerometers, gyroscopes, magnetometers, star trackers, or optical navigation sensors.

  • Experience with spacecraft or aircraft platforms.

  • Familiarity with GNC architectures, navigation algorithms, sensor fusion, and estimation techniques.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly.

data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

We are looking for a Senior ECLSS Systems & Product Development Engineer to strengthen the ECLSS team across system engineering, CFD, product development, verification and testing.

The successful candidate will act as a senior technical contributor across the ECLSS perimeter, supporting CFD analyses, complex technical topics, challenging designs and models, and driving cross-functional activities with internal teams, suppliers and agencies. A particular focus will be placed on strengthening our capabilities in CFD, while bringing hands-on experience from the development and qualification of Environmental Control, Air Revitalization, Air Circulation or HVAC systems.

You will work closely with the ECLSS team and will report directly to the ECLSS Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and support CFD activities for cargo bay and vestibule, including modelling strategy, assumptions, boundary conditions, model justification.

  • Support the development of ECLSS system (Air circulation, pressurization control, crew emergency), identifying critical design aspects and potential technical issues.

  • Provide technical support during product development, from requirements and architecture through detailed design, verification and qualification logic.

  • Support definition of the environmental test campaigns (objectives, test bench, planning, test article procurement)

  • Define CFD validation and verification strategy.

  • Correlate analytical, Ecosim and CFD models for the air revitilization and pressure control system with test data and define appropriate acceptance criteria and uncertainty margins.

  • Lead focused technical working groups, trade-offs and root-cause investigations.

  • Drive co-engineering activities with suppliers, other spacecraft disciplines and external agencies.

  • Support the preparation of system, sub-system and component reviews

  • Support the continuous improvement of ECLSS engineering methods, modelling practices and development processes.

  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Profile

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in Environment Control System design for cabin, preferably within aircraft, space or military industries.

  • Strong expertise in CFD, including model construction, turbulence modelling, meshing, convergence, validation and correlation against test data.

  • Proficiency in ANSYS Fluent, STAR-CCM+, or OpenFOAM.

  • Familiarity with GitHub and Python for analysis automation.

  • Strong understanding of low-pressure and low-speed air-flow systems, including pressure losses, fans/blowers, ducting, valves and system-level performance.

  • Proven experience in hardware/product development and testing, ideally from early design through qualification.

  • Experience with environmental testing such as TVAC, thermal balance, mechanical tests, pressure tests.

  • Familiarity with relevant NASA standards and verification practices is highly desirable.

  • Ability to lead technical discussions and communicate effectively with suppliers, agencies and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

  • Pragmatic, hands-on engineering mindset with the ability to identify critical issues and drive them toward closure.

  • Experience leading or mentoring engineers.

  • Fluent in English. German, French and Italian are an asset

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


Description

We are seeking a talented Fluid Systems Development Engineer to join the Storm engine project. As a key member of our System Team, you will play a central role in developing key fluid systems of the engine.

Key Responsibilities

As a Fluid Systems Development Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

  • Translate engine-level functional and performance requirements into fluid-system requirements, architectures, and development priorities.

  • Lead architecture trade-off studies, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments to support robust design decisions.

myCompanee betreibt eine Multi-Tenant-SaaS-Plattform für Kantine, Vending und POS – mit rund 180 Produktiv-Tenants und über 750 Containern.

• Pflege der Datenschicht: MySQL 8.0 mit Replikation und über 180 Tenant-Datenbanken, Redis, RabbitMQ

• Logging, Monitoring und Alerting mit Elasticsearch, Prometheus und Grafana

• Unterstützung bei der Modernisierung: Flutter-Rewrite der Mobile-App, Ablösung von Legacy-Komponenten

Unser Tech Stack

• Backend: C# / .NET, ASP.NET Core, Ocelot API-Gateway, IdentityServer4 (OIDC, JWT), ASP.NET Identity, SignalR

• Frontend & Backoffice: Blazor, Python/Flask mit gunicorn, jsreport

• Mobile: Flutter (Rewrite), Xamarin (Legacy), Azure Notification Hubs

• Messaging & Cache: RabbitMQ (AMQP), Redis (Cache, Pub/Sub, Sessions)

• Datenbanken: MySQL 8.0 (Master/Replica), SQLite

• Infrastruktur: Docker Swarm, nginx, Hetzner Cloud, Docker Hub

• Observability: Elasticsearch 7, Prometheus, Grafana, cAdvisor, node-exporter, Slack-Alerting

• Integrationen: VR Pay, SEPA, EVIS, Kassensysteme

Dein Profil:

Das bringst du mit

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit C# und ASP.NET Core

• Erfahrung mit verteilten Systemen und Microservices, idealerweise mit API-Gateways und Message Brokern (RabbitMQ)

• Solides Wissen zu relationalen Datenbanken, bevorzugt MySQL, inklusive Performance-Tuning und Replikation

• Praxis mit Docker und Container-Orchestrierung

• Verständnis von OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect und JWT-basierter Authentifizierung

• Sicherer Umgang mit Linux, nginx, TLS und Netzwerkgrundlagen

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) und gutes Englisch

Pluspunkte

• Erfahrung mit Multi-Tenant-SaaS-Architekturen

• Erfahrung mit Zahlungsanbietern, Kassensystemen oder Geräteanbindungen

• Kenntnisse in Angular, Blazor, Python/Flask oder Flutter

• Erfahrung mit IdentityServer4 oder Duende IdentityServer

• Branchenbezug zu Gemeinschaftsverpflegung, Kantine oder Gastronomie

Was wir bieten

• Echte Ende-zu-Ende-Verantwortung: vom Code über das Deployment bis zum Monitoring
