Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo.

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich.

Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen.

  • Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse.

  • Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist.

  • In Snowflake und mit KI-Tools wie Claude analysierst du Daten eigenständig, findest die relevanten Hebel und priorisierst Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact.

  • Mit Marketing, Product, Revenue Management und BI arbeitest du eng zusammen und machst Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für CRM nutzbar. Dem Team, das Kampagnen und Content umsetzt, lieferst du Segmente, Journey-Konzepte und klare Briefings.

  • Du verantwortest Datenqualität und Governance deiner Segmente, Events und Systeme und stellst sicher, dass alles performant, sicher und datenschutzkonform läuft.

  • Du baust unser CRM komplett neu auf und übernimmst die Projektverantwortung für die Integration in unsere System- und Datenlandschaft, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum Go-live. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Ausgeprägter Datenblick: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten in Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Data Warehouses, baust komplexe Segmente und Kohorten und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen ab.

  • Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen.

  • Du bist komplett KI-enabled: Tools wie Claude oder MCP nutzt du ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail.

  • Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Einführung eines CRM-Systems: Du übernimmst Ownership, treibst die Integration als Projekt eigenverantwortlich voran und koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und Dienstleister.

  • Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven!

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

data.description:
Novaspace is seeking a Working Student to join our Munich office, supporting our team across a diverse range of consulting, innovation advisory and business activities in the space sector. 

Our team in Munich advises clients across industry, government and the wider space ecosystem. Our work spans market assessment, strategy and business planning, policy development, due diligence and M&A, innovation advisory, technology strategy & foresight, space solutions enablement, and community outreach and training. 

As a Working Student, you will work alongside our consultants and contribute to client projects as well as internal activities. Depending on your interests, skills and project needs, you will gain hands-on exposure to different types of assignments and stakeholders across the European and international space ecosystem.


Your tasks may include

  • Conducting desktop research and qualitative and quantitative analysis on markets, technologies, companies, policies and innovation ecosystems 

  • Supporting innovation advisory activities, including research on start-ups and emerging technologies, ecosystem and stakeholder mapping, and analysis of innovation programmes and initiatives 

  • Contributing to market assessments, strategy projects, policy studies, technology foresight and due diligence assignments 

  • Supporting the preparation and delivery of workshops, stakeholder engagements, training sessions and community activities 

  • Preparing presentations, reports, briefing materials and other client deliverables 

  • Gathering, structuring and synthesising information and translating findings into clear insights 

  • Supporting project coordination and communication with clients, partners and other stakeholders 

  • Contributing to internal initiatives and the development of our consulting and innovation activities 

  • Supporting selected administrative, organisational and financial processes that help our Munich office run effectively 

  • The exact mix of responsibilities will vary depending on ongoing projects and your background, giving you the opportunity to gain exposure to different areas of our business. 

    • We offer

  • Hands-on experience in management consulting and innovation advisory within the space sector 

  • Exposure to a broad range of topics spanning business, policy, technology and innovation 

  • The opportunity to develop your research, analytical, communication and consulting skills alongside experienced colleagues 

  • An international and collaborative working environment in an attractive area of downtown Munich 

  • Intellectual challenges combined with work-life balance and limited travel 

  • Exposure to clients and stakeholders across industry, government, research and the entrepreneurial ecosystem 

  • The opportunity to build a unique professional network across the European and international space sector 


    • Desired skills & experience

    We are interested in candidates from a broad range of academic backgrounds who are curious about the space sector and eager to learn. You do not need to be a space expert when you join us. 

    Ideally, you bring: 

  • Current enrolment at a university or higher education institution 

  • A strong academic record and intellectual curiosity 

  • Fluency in English 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an interest in qualitative and/or quantitative analysis 

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to present information in a structured way 

  • An interest in business, technology, policy, entrepreneurship and/or innovation 

  • The ability to learn quickly, take ownership of tasks and work in a structured and reliable manner 

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in an international team 

  • Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to contribute across different types of projects and activities 

    •  

    Any of the following would be a plus
     

    We do not expect candidates to bring experience in all of these areas. Relevant interests or experience could include: 

  • Space business, Earth observation, satellite navigation, space applications or other areas of the space economy 

  • Innovation, entrepreneurship, start-ups, technology transfer or innovation ecosystems 

  • Strategy, market research, economics, finance or investment 

  • Public policy, government programmes or international organisations 

  • Technology strategy, emerging technologies or foresight 

  • Engineering, natural sciences, economics, business, public policy or another relevant academic field 

  • Experience organising or supporting workshops, events, training or stakeholder engagement 

  • Working proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or another European language 

    •  

    About Novaspace
     
    Novaspace is the global leading consulting firm in the space sector. With a robust 40-year legacy of expertise in guiding private companies and government entities through strategic decisionmaking processes, Novaspace offers end-to-end consulting services, from project strategy definition to implementation, providing data-led perspectives on critical issues. Our mission is to empower clients with strategic and technical insights, enabling them to navigate and seize new opportunities within the rapidly evolving space sector. As a privately owned and fully independent organization, Novaspace presents an expanded portfolio of services, featuring combined expertise in management and technology consulting, top-tier executive summits, and market intelligence. Trusted by 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace has offices strategically located in Brussels, Montreal, Munich, Paris, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington D.C. Working at Novaspace will give you the opportunity to boost your career in the space/consulting industry where our role is to support the decision-makers by providing them the highest quality support in everything we do: consulting, market intelligence, training and summits.
     
    Only Applications containing a Motivation Letter and a CV in English will be considered.

Your Role

Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Kundenservice für unsere FINN Station spielst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau und der Betreuung unserer physischen FINN Stationen. Du arbeitest hands-on im täglichen operativen Geschäft, gestaltest Prozesse aktiv mit und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team ein herausragendes Kundenerlebnis vor Ort. Dadurch schaffst du eine nahtlose, skalierbare Customer Journey für eines der innovativsten Konzepte von FINN.


Your Mission

  • Gestalte und betreue den täglichen Ablauf an der FINN Station von der Fahrzeugübergabe bis zur Rückgabe mit höchster Servicequalität.

  • Baue kontinuierliche Feedback-Schleifen auf, um die Kundenerfahrung direkt vor Ort stetig zu optimieren.

  • Erstelle klare Prozessdokumentationen und KPI-Dashboards zur Messung und Verbesserung der operativen Stations-Performance.

  • Unterstütze beim Auf- und Ausbau skalierbarer Partnerschaften mit externen Dienstleistern für reibungslose Abläufe.

  • Biete den Kund:innen einen herausragenden Service und löse Herausforderungen im Tagesgeschäft pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert.

  • Trage aktiv dazu bei, die physische Präsenz und Markenwahrnehmung von FINN vor Ort kontinuierlich zu stärken.


    • Your Profile

    Must-have:

  • Immatrikulierte:r Student:in an einer staatlich anerkannten Hochschule mit der Möglichkeit, während des Semesters 20 Std./Woche und in den Semesterferien bis zu 40 Std./Woche zu arbeiten.

  • Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie eine stark serviceorientierte und kundenfokussierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität und unternehmerisches Denken mit Freude an selbstständigem Anpacken.

  • Gültiger Führerschein der Klasse B (PKW) sowie fließende Deutschkenntnisse (C1/C2) und gute Englischkenntnisse (B2).

    • Nice-to-have:

  • Erste praktische Erfahrung im Customer Experience-, Kundenservice- oder operativen Umfeld.

  • Kreative und strukturierte Herangehensweise bei der Lösung unvorhergesehener operativer Herausforderungen.

    •  


    WHY FINN

  • Attractive Compensation (Attraktives Gehalt): Deine Leistung wird belohnt. Bei uns erwartet dich eine attraktive Vergütung von 16,00 Euro pro Stunde für deinen Einsatz und dein Engagement im Team.

  • Health & Mindset (Sport & Gesundheit): Deine Energie ist unser Antrieb. Profitiere von einer subventionierten EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft für Fitness und Sport.

  • Fast-Track Career Growth (Karriere & Weiterentwicklung): Lerne von den Besten. In unserem schnell wachsenden, dynamischen Umfeld hast du die Möglichkeit, aktiv mitzugestalten, steil zu lernen und dich beruflich sowie persönlich rasant weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Team Spirit & Corporate Events: Wir sind mehr als nur Kolleg:innen. Ob Sommer-Events am See oder einfach ein entspannter After-Work-Drink. Wir feiern unsere Meilensteine bei regelmäßigen Teamevents gemeinsam.


    • About Us
    FINN ist Deutschlands führende Auto-Abo-Plattform und eines der wenigen deutschen Unicorns im Mobility-Sektor. Mit über 400 Kolleg:innen aus mehr als 40 Nationen bauen wir an der Zukunft der Mobilität und machen den Zugang zum eigenen Auto so unkompliziert wie nie zuvor. Was uns dabei wirklich stolz macht, sind aber nicht nur die Zahlen, sondern das, was dahintersteckt: unser starker Team-Drive, der Wille, den Status quo zu challengen, und die Ambition, wirklich etwas zu bewegen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Scale-ups in Deutschland direkt Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere Success Story aktiv mitzugestalten. Wir fangen gerade erst an!
     
    Weitere Informationen: www.finn.com

     

    Gleiche Chancen für Alle

    FINN steht für die Chancengleichheit aller ein. Wir begrüßen und feiern Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeiter:innen zu schaffen. Wir stehen allen Personengruppen offen, unabhängig von Alter, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, Ethnizität, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität und/oder -ausdruck, Familienstand oder anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmalen.

Industry leader? Well, how about an industry creator?!
 
WalkMe, an SAP company, pioneered the world's leading Digital Adoption Platform, helping organizations navigate change across any application or system. Today it is the platform that drives AI adoption across the enterprise. Enterprise work stays fragmented across applications, and that fragmentation compounds as AI advances. Traditional training and vendor-provided help leave organizations managing change one application at a time. WalkMe guides people through change, brings AI into the flow of work, automates tasks and shows executives how workflows perform. Global leaders including IBM, Nestlé, Thermo Fisher Scientific, and the U.S. federal government trust WalkMe. WalkMe turns AI potential into AI performance.
 
So, if you’re an expert in your field, and looking for an opportunity to work, collaborate, and innovate with some of the most talented people out there, WalkMe is the place for you!

The Senior Professional Services Consultant is one of the most impactful roles at WalkMe. You will own the end-to-end implementation of our digital adoption platform for some of the world most complex and high-stakes organisations — including global defence and government primes, where getting user adoption right isn't just a product metric, it's mission-critical.
You'll partner directly with customers to design and build solutions that drive meaningful change in how enterprise users, from commercial software teams to defence programme offices  interact with complex platforms. You'll report to the Director of Professional Services, EMEA.

What You'll Own
  • WalkMe Implementation: Design, build, and implement interactive experiences for our customers to drive business impact, such as enhancing their end-user onboarding experience and accelerating feature adoption.
  • Consultation: Work closely with customer application owners to understand their business objectives, pain points, and end-user needs. Provide expert advice and recommend WalkMe solutions that align with their goals and improve user experiences.
  • Project Management: Lead end-to-end WalkMe projects, collaborating with customers, internal stakeholders, and the development team to ensure successful delivery within scope, timeline, and budget.
  • Data Analysis: Monitor and analyze WalkMe usage data and user feedback to identify opportunities for optimization and improvement. Constantly strive to increase WalkMe's effectiveness and user engagement.
  • Knowledge Transfer: Conduct training sessions for customers on WalkMe best practices, ensuring they can make the most of the product and effectively utilize its features to enhance their applications.
  • Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve any issues related to WalkMe implementation, ensuring smooth functionality across different platforms and devices.
  • Collaboration: Foster strong cross-functional collaboration with UX/UI designers, developers, customer success teams, and other stakeholders.

    • What You'll Need to Succeed
  • Strong understanding of user behaviour and how to improve user engagement through WalkMe.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to customise and integrate WalkMe elements into web applications.
  • Analytical mindset, capable of interpreting data to make data-driven decisions and optimise WalkMe implementations.
  • Attention to detail, ensuring WalkMe elements are visually appealing, user-friendly, and aligned with our brand guidelines.
  • Problem-solving skills, capable of troubleshooting and resolving issues related to WalkMe implementations.
  • Experience working in an agile development environment is a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in Professional Services, Implementation Consulting, or Customer Success.
  • 3+ years of SaaS experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field preferred.

    • What Sets Us Apart
  • At WalkMe, we are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our global community and clients we serve through inclusive programs and initiatives including equal pay, employee resource groups, holistic benefits and more.  We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture which celebrates the unique experiences and perspectives each Team Member brings to the workplace.
  • Hybrid Work Arrangement: We offer a hybrid work schedule to perfectly combine the benefits of remote work and the essential connections and collaborations of onsite work.
  • Supportive Culture: We focus on the whole person, celebrating what makes us unique, and create space for community.
  • Professional Development: We encourage continuous learning and offer opportunities for career development through our career compass offering.
  • Stay healthy and happy with Wellness@WalkMe! Enjoy quarterly wellness reimbursements, daily BrightBreaks to recharge, and WalkMe’s annual Wellness Month every July—because your well-being matters all year long.
  • WalkMe provides health coverage options, where applicable, to ensure employees have access to essential medical benefits. Our offerings are designed to support the well-being and diverse needs of our global workforce.
  • WalkMe offers a generous annual leave policy tailored to meet regional standards, ensuring all employees enjoy sufficient time off to rest and recharge.
  • WalkMe offers RefreshMe Days throughout the year to further strengthen our commitment to work/life balance.
  • Robust Retirement Contributions: Ask HR about the specific offerings for your region!
  • SAP's acquisition of WalkMe highlights a commitment to enhancing user experience and streamlining software interactions, offering opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology that drives efficiency and innovation in the workplace.
    • At WalkMe, we approach Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) with the same level of collaboration, innovation and accountability that we bring to the rest of our business. We believe in the value of diversity and are committed to ensuring an equitable and inclusive workplace where every employee has an equal opportunity to achieve success.

Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.

The Senior Solutions Engineer is a member of the Saviynt Sales organization,responsible for collaborating with the Sales Directors and Regional VPs to sell anintegrated suite of Access Governance and Cloud Security solutions to new and existingaccounts.  This individual will have a broad understanding of vendor solutions, industrybest practices, and technology integration, demonstrating expertise and delivery offunctional and technical solutions to sophisticated customer engagements.
 
This individual will also provide expert knowledge to existing and prospective customers through conducting detailed technical discovery, responses to Request for Proposals(RFPs), and delivery of Proof of Concepts (POCs). Besides, this individual will be a contributor to Product Marketing collaborating in the development of white papers, solutions briefs, webinars, and blogs. The Senior Solutions Engineer will work proactively, and independently with various facets of the business ultimately driving opportunities to closure and possibility impacting revenue.
 
The Senior Solutions Engineer will be expected to mentor/coach Solutions Engineers on strategy, influencing the customer, managing scope, and execution of technical presentations. This person must be located in Munich/ Frankfurt/ Stuttgart / Germany and will work remotely + travel.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING
  • Develop and deliver technical presentations to demonstrate enterprise solutions, ease-of-configuration, simplicity of architecture, and intelligence of workflows providing the opportunity for customer interaction and demonstrating excellent presentation skills.
  • Effectively communicate solution value to the business and technical audiences that is clear and satisfies prospective customer requirements and/or inquiries.
  • Provide needs assessment, consultation, technical solutions, and customer support with a team of Saviynt professionals.
  • Collaborate with both the sales and global bid team members to respond to satisfy prospective customer inquiries resulting from an RFx.
  • Assist members of the global bid team and collaborate with members of the product management team in the curation of RFx responses.
  • Effectively communicate with sales directors and sales management, working proactively and independently to prioritize and manage top regional opportunities, driving them to closure.
  • Regularly provide solution feedback and competitive intel from the field to Saviynt product management, solutions strategy, and marketing teams.
  • Ramp and coach Solutions Engineers on solution demonstration, RFP responses and presentations, technical overviews, POC scope management, and execution.
  • Up to 60% international travel across the DACH region

    • WHAT YOU BRING
  • Fluent in English and German. Other European languages are a plus (written/spoken)
  • Domain expertise - Privilege Access Management,  Identity Governance and Administration, Application GRC, and/or, Cloud Security
  • Minimum of five (5) years previous Solutions Engineering with demonstrable success in Cloud Security, Privileged Access Management, Application GRC, and/or Identity Governance and Administration solutions
  • Bachelor's degree in information systems or related area, or demonstration of equivalent knowledge such as technical certifications from ISACA, (ISC)², AWS Cloud Practitioner, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, Google Cloud Security Engineer, etc.
  • Ability to travel up to 60% across the DACH region
  • Superior communication, relationship and customer service skills that result in the ability to rapidly assess needs and sell solutions to sophisticated customers.
  • Ownership and management of technical team relationships within existing and prospective opportunities
  • Self-sufficient with a high degree of autonomy and a passion for working within a dynamic startup-like environment
  • Exemplary technical skills enabling configuration and rapid problem solving in the field including:
  • Experience in Identity Governance and Administration domain with firm grasp of its concepts such as Identity Life Cycle Management, Entitlements Management, Access Request, Workflow, Policy and Role Management, Access Certification, Audit, Reporting/Analytics, and Deployment Scenarios
  • Database query experience in a relational database environment (MySQL and Elastic Search)
  • Experience with REST API, PowerShell, and GraphAPI
  • Knowledge of authentication and authorization protocols and standards including SAML, OAuth/2, SCIM, OpenID, WS-Trust, SPNEGO, x.509, SPML, Kerberos, REST, JSON, and others that facilitate Single Sign On (SSO), ID federation, etc.
  • Understanding of data governance concepts and compliance regulations such as GDPR & CCPA
  • Experience with regulatory compliance and security frameworks such as SOX, NERC-CIP, HIPAA, Cobit, Center for Internet Security (CIS), Cloud Security Alliance, NIST, PCI, etc.
  • Experience with AzureAD, Okta, JumpCloud, OneLogin, PingDirectory, Active Directory, eDirectory, Oracle Internet Directory, Radiant Logic, and other Cloud/LDAP/Virtual directories
  • Basic understanding of networking technologies such as HTTP, TCP/IP, firewalls, and encryption
  • Exemplary communication and relationship skills (verbal, written and presentations)
  • Strong business and technical document creation skills (e.g. scope definition, proposals, architecture and network diagrams, etc.)
    • Saviynt is an amazing place to work. We are a high-growth, Platform as a Service company focused on Identity Authority to power and protect the world at work. You will experience tremendous growth and learning opportunities through challenging yet rewarding work which directly impacts our customers, all within a welcoming and positive work environment. If you're resilient and enjoy working in a dynamic environment you belong with us!

    Security & Compliance
    This role requires adherence to Saviynt’s information security and privacy policies and procedures, including annual security training.

    Saviynt is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome everyone to our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Senior Partner Success Manager – Recruit DACH (all genders) 

Companial is looking for a commercially driven senior Partner Success Manager – Recruit to grow our partner community across the DACH region.

In this role, your main focus is new business. You will identify, approach and recruit Microsoft partners across Germany, Austria and Switzerland and introduce them to the value Companial can bring to their business.

As an ambassador for Companial and Microsoft, you will build relationships with new partners, understand their business needs and turn opportunities into long term partnerships. You will work closely with our regional sales and marketing teams and with Microsoft to further strengthen Companial's presence in the DACH market.

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Lederindustrie! 🌍✨

Du hast keine Lust auf einen typischen Studi-Job, bei dem du nur zuarbeitest? Bei uns bist du von Anfang an nah am operativen Filialgeschäft und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung für eine feste Gruppe von Stores.

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Filialmanagement / Retail Operations wirst du Teil unseres Retail-Teams in Rostock und arbeitest eng mit unseren Store Managern und verschiedenen Bereichen der Zentrale zusammen. Dabei lernst du, wie Stores wirtschaftlich gesteuert, Teams koordiniert und operative Herausforderungen gelöst werden.

Dabei lernst du, wie erfolgreiche Filialsteuerung in der Praxis funktioniert – mit dem Ziel, dich langfristig auf eine Position als Area Manager vorzubereiten.

Deine Mission 🧭

  • Stores begleiten: Du unterstützt bei der Betreuung von 5–6 Stores und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team dafür, dass Prozesse, Standards und Abläufe funktionieren.

  • Kennzahlen verstehen: Du arbeitest mit Umsätzen, Warenbeständen und Reportings, erkennst Entwicklungen und leitest gemeinsam mit deinem Team Lead passende Maßnahmen ab.

  • Kommunizieren & koordinieren: Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Store-Teams und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen in der Zentrale zusammen.

  • Organisation übernehmen: Du koordinierst Store-relevante Themen, behältst offene Aufgaben im Blick und sorgst für strukturierte Abläufe und Dokumentationen.

  • Führung kennenlernen: Du begleitest Gespräche mit Store Managern und Team Leads und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Führung und Entwicklung von Teams.

  • Eigene Projekte übernehmen: Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du selbstständig eigene Themen und Projekte – zum Beispiel bei der Eröffnung eines neuen Stores.

Das bringst du mit 💼

  • Wirtschaftliches Studium: Idealerweise studierst du BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Handelsmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang.

Du musst noch nicht alles können. Wir geben dir die Möglichkeit, deine Stärken auszubauen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Was Dich bei Gusti Leder erwartet 🌿

  • Faire Vergütung: 17–19 € Stundenlohn zzgl. Bonusmodell sowie 20 % Mitarbeiterrabatt und zusätzliche Prämien.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Deine Arbeitszeiten lassen sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren.

  • Onboarding & Weiterbildung: Du erhältst eine strukturierte Einarbeitung, Unterstützung durch deinen Team Lead sowie Zugang zu internen und externen Trainings.

  • Teamkultur: Dich erwarten flache Hierarchien, direkte Kommunikation, regelmäßige Teamevents und ein Arbeitsumfeld rund um Nachhaltigkeit und Slow Fashion.

  • Zentrale Lage: Unser Büro liegt nahe der Universität und dem Rostocker Hauptbahnhof und ist mit Fahrrad und öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln gut erreichbar. Kostenlose Parkplätze stehen ebenfalls zur Verfügung.

  • Gut versorgt: Zweimal pro Woche gibt es ein frisch gekochtes Mittagessen. Kaffee, Tee, Wasser und frisches Obst stehen dir täglich kostenfrei zur Verfügung.

Bewirb dich jetzt als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Filialmanagement / Retail Operations und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit uns weiter.

Bei Adlares machen wir Methanemissionen aus der Luft sichtbar – hochpräzise, zertifiziert und entscheidend für den Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur und den Klimaschutz. Mit unserem laserbasierten Messsystem CHARM® setzen wir den Industriestandard für die luftgestützte Gasfernüberwachung – und entwickeln aktuell die nächste, plattformunabhängige Systemgeneration (CHARM®3) sowie modernisierte Daten- und Auswerteprozesse im laufenden Betrieb.

Damit diese Neuentwicklung verlässlich gelingt, suchen wir eine Person mit hohen kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du stellst sicher, dass wir unsere Softwareentwicklung verbindlich planen und zum Ziel führen. Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement die Ziele, übersetzt sie in einen realistischen Plan und trägst die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. So bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson im Planungsprozess.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ziele & Anforderungen: Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement, dem Leiter IT und dem PO definierst du die Ziele der Softwareentwicklung. Du holst Anforderungen bei Operations, Laser- und Hardwareentwicklern und Nutzenden ein, erkennst Lücken und Widersprüche und übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare, umsetzbare Arbeitspakete für die Softwareentwicklung.

  • Planung & Kapazitäten: Du zerlegst Vorhaben in Epics und Tasks, planst Kapazitäten realistisch – inklusive Puffer für Betrieb und Tagesgeschäft – und machst Abhängigkeiten zu Hardware, Physik und Systemintegration frühzeitig sichtbar.

  • Umsetzungsverantwortung: Du sorgst dafür, dass Zusagen eingehalten werden: Du leitest das Daily, machst Fortschritt und Risiken transparent und steuerst nach, wenn etwas aus dem Plan läuft.

  • Entscheidungen herbeiführen: Offene Fragen bleiben bei dir nicht liegen. Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor, führst sie im Team oder mit dem Produktmanagement herbei, hältst sie fest und verfolgst ihre Umsetzung.

  • Architektur im Team: Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team gemeinsam mit der IT-Leitung. Du moderierst diese Runden, bringst die Perspektive von Aufwand, Risiko und Planbarkeit ein und überführst die Ergebnisse in den Plan – auch bei der Frage, was wir am Bestand weiterführen und was wir schrittweise ablösen.

  • Mitentwickeln: Rund 20–30 % deiner Zeit arbeitest du selbst im Code, in Reviews oder an Prototypen. So kannst du Machbarkeit und Aufwand fundiert einschätzen.


  • Planungserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Planung und Steuerung von Softwareentwicklung mit agilen und strukturierten Methoden – idealerweise in einem Umfeld, in dem Software, Hardware und Messtechnik zusammenkommen.

  • Verbindlichkeit: Du schaffst Klarheit und Verbindlichkeit.

  • Teamgeist: Unser multidisziplinäres Team aus Physikern, Software- und IT Entwicklern, Konstrukteuren und Datenanalysten bringt 25 Jahre Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von LIDAR Systemen mit. Du bindest alle Stakeholder in den Zielfindungsprozess ein.

  • Analytisches Gespür: Du ziehst aus Gesprächen mit sehr unterschiedlichen Beteiligten das fachlich Relevante heraus und erkennst Lücken und Missverständnisse früh.

  • Entscheidungsstärke: Du führst Entscheidungen aktiv herbei, auch wenn noch nicht alle Informationen vorliegen, und hältst nach, dass sie umgesetzt werden.

  • Technisches Fundament: Fundierte Entwicklungspraxis mit Python, sicherer Umgang mit Prinzipien guter Softwareentwicklung und Verständnis für C++.

  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit der Ablösung gewachsener Systeme (z. B. LabVIEW), mit Datenbanken, Messdaten und Signalverarbeitung sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung. Dazu Neugier auf Spektroskopie, Laserphysik und Optik.

Was dich erwartet

  • Wirksamkeit: Eine Schlüsselrolle in einem zentralen Neuentwicklungsprojekt, in der du Planung, Arbeitsweise und Verlässlichkeit unserer Softwareentwicklung maßgeblich prägst.

  • Interdisziplinäres Team: Zusammenarbeit mit Fachleuten aus Physik, Ingenieurwesen und Softwareentwicklung – mit kurzen Wegen und offener Kommunikation.

  • Sinnstiftende Mission: Eine zertifizierte Technologie mit direktem Beitrag zu Anlagensicherheit und Klimaschutz.

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We are looking for a highly structured, hands-on Senior People Operations Project & Process Manager (m/f/d) to join our European HR Operations team. This is a senior role for someone who takes on our tougher operational problems and drives them forward together with the teams involved. You will be a driving force behind scaling, harmonizing, and digitizing our People Operations processes. Your scope is Europe, with selected global projects and touchpoints on top.

At Flix, People Operations is a team with genuine ownership, business impact, and a seat at the table. As one of the senior drivers of our process landscape, you work alongside the wider team rather than alone, and you are a trusted senior voice on how our processes and projects fit together across markets. Your work directly shapes how HR operations functions at Flix, today in Europe and tomorrow on a global scale.

Our People Operations team is going through a significant digital transformation, with AI as a central part of how we are rethinking the way we work. Multiple projects are running in parallel across European and global scope, and this role contributes directly to that agenda. You do not need to arrive with deep AI expertise, but you need to be someone who is genuinely interested in exploring what AI-driven approaches can do for People Operations and who wants to grow with us in that direction. We have the people and the knowledge to develop these capabilities together.

This role is based in Berlin (hybrid model).

About the Role

  • Process Landscape Management & Optimization: Analyze, document, and continuously advance our People Operations process landscape across Europe. Map existing workflows, identify bottlenecks, and design lean, standardized, and scalable processes with global applicability in mind, keeping documentation and standards up to date as the organization evolves. Working with the Digital Transformation and Tech teams, you translate operational pain points into clear requirements, and drive automation where it creates real value on the ground
  • End-to-End Project Leadership & Change Management: Own complex, cross-functional HR initiatives end to end, including policy rollouts, compliance frameworks, operational restructuring, and transformation projects. You (co)-lead these independently from scoping through execution to handover, set the pace and the milestones, manage stakeholders and dependencies across markets, create operational playbooks, and ensure teams transition smoothly to new ways of working
  • Central Ops Counterpart: You are the central point of contact and the representative for People Operations in cross-functional projects, most importantly with our People Partners and the Digital Transformation team, and additionally with our Centers of Excellence and other stakeholders such as Finance. You make sure People Operations has a clear, informed voice in these initiatives across Europe and at global level, and you bring the operational perspective consistently into every cross-functional conversation
  • Day-to-Day Enablement: You actively support local European People Ops Managers by delivering tangible process improvements that make their daily work faster, safer, and easier

About You

  • Experience: 5+ years in HR Operations, HR Project Management, within a fast-paced, international organization or matrix environment
  • Process Expertise: Deep, hands-on track record of designing, mapping, and implementing complex HR processes, and of being the go-to person others rely on when a process spans multiple teams, departments, and markets
  • Project Management: You (co)-lead cross-functional projects end to end and independently, manage diverse stakeholders and dependencies, and keep scope, timelines, and budgets in check without close supervision
  • Tech-Savvy & AI Mindset: You have a solid understanding of modern HRIS and HR Service Delivery tools. You make decisions based on data and are genuinely curious about what AI and automation can do for People Operations. You do not need to be an expert today, but the interest and openness need to be there. We invest in building these capabilities together
  • Communicator: You can align different departments, push back constructively when needed, and simplify complex operational topics for any audience. Fluent in English; additional European languages, especially German, are a strong plus
  • Mindset: You push boundaries to challenge the status quo, and you build for generations by creating robust, audit-proof frameworks rather than quick fixes

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Client Success Senior Manager to our Client Success team in Munich!

You'll manage a set of high-profile corporate accounts in Germany, ensuring that our clients remain focused on our mission of making wellbeing universal. You'll also drive the commercial agenda within your portfolio of clients, and collaborate with other teams to ensure that take-up of Wellhub is high within all of the accounts that you manage. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team and work with talented people and some of Germany's most innovative companies. We're looking for a superstar candidate who can help the team to achieve new levels of success.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Own client relationships for a portfolio of large corporate accounts throughout the entire post-sale client lifecycle in Germany, leading all in-person and virtual client communications and meetings.
  • Ensure trusting, high-value partnerships with HR contacts, Procurement counterparts, and C-level executives by articulating Wellhub's mission to enhance employee health, engagement, and happiness.
  • Drive the commercial agenda across your account portfolio, leading annual contract renewals, expansions, and renegotiations to deliver continuous value.
  • Lead client launches, ongoing strategic relaunch initiatives, and awareness events in close partnership with the Wellhub Wellbeing Engagement Team for end-to-end execution.
  • Present and implement best-practice workflows, evaluate member growth metrics, suggest targeted adoption strategies, and provide continuous platform updates.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners—including Customer Experience, Operations, User Growth Marketing, Fitness Partnerships, Business Development, and Wellbeing Engagement teams—to build adoption strategies and hit shared goals.
  • Analyze client data and metrics to deliver actionable findings, shaping tailored communication and awareness campaigns that boost user engagement and defeat inactivity.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.


WHO YOU ARE

  • An accomplished relationship leader with 5+ years of experience managing complex client relationships in a client-facing capacity.
  • A commercial driver with proven expertise leading end-to-end contract negotiations for renewals, upsells, and cross-sells, aligning client growth goals with company revenue targets.
  • A dynamic and collaborative partner who thrives in team environments, brings creative problem-solving skills, and works seamlessly with cross-functional groups.
  • An exceptional communicator who provides superior customer service to both internal stakeholders and executive-level external clients.
  • A detail-oriented project manager with deep experience orchestrating multiple complex client deliverables and priorities concurrently.
  • An analytical thinker fluent in tracking data, interpreting performance reports, and leveraging insights into concrete operational strategies.
  • A process innovator capable of refining job protocols, optimizing workflows, and proactively navigating change in a fast-paced global business environment.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in enterprise client relationship management and commercial contract negotiations are mandatory requirements.


WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.

🎤 Warum voize? Weil wir mehr als nur ein Job sind!

Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren.

Unsere Vision ist es, das zu ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik - wir verstärken ihre Wirkung.

Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag.

Und jetzt suchen wir dich, damit du mit uns auf diese Mission gehst!

💡 Deine Mission - Pflegekräfte begeistern und Digitalisierung im Pflegealltag gestalten

Als Onboarding Manager:in - Trainer:in für digitale Pflegedokumentation sorgst du dafür, dass Pflegekräfte unseren KI-Begleiter sicher im Alltag nutzen. Du schulst Gruppen von 10 bis 15 Pflegekräften direkt bei unseren Kund:innen nach der Teach-Try-Apply-Methode und bringst deine Pflegeerfahrung ein, damit aus Dokumentationszeit wieder Zeit für Zuwendung wird.

🚀 Dein Arbeitsalltag - Keine zwei Tage sind gleich

  • Schulungen vor Ort leiten: Du gestaltest und führst eigenverantwortlich Schulungen nach der Teach-Try-Apply-Methode (TTA: Erklären, Ausprobieren, Anwenden) durch und begleitest Pflegekräfte dabei, voize direkt in ihrem Arbeitsalltag anzuwenden.

  • Online schulen: Je nach Bedarf schulst du per Videocall in einem eigenen Format, das nicht dem TTA-Ablauf folgt.

  • Digitalisierung begleiten: Du unterstützt Pflegekräfte bei neuen digitalen Arbeitsweisen und begleitest sie durch Veränderungen, damit der KI-Begleiter im Alltag wirklich ankommt.

  • Pflegeexpertise einbringen: Du erkennst Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse in unterschiedlichen Einrichtungen und gibst sie gemeinsam mit Support und Customer Success direkt an unsere Produktteams weiter.

  • Schulungen weiterentwickeln: Du verbesserst Materialien und Abläufe laufend anhand von Feedback und Stolpersteinen im Onboarding.

🤝 Dein Profil - Das bringst du mit

  • Pflegeausbildung oder praktische Erfahrung in der Pflege (stationäre Langzeitpflege, Krankenhaus oder ambulant) - du kennst Pflegedokumentation und Alltagsroutinen aus eigener Erfahrung.

  • Erfahrung darin, Kolleg:innen anzuleiten, z. B. als Praxisanleiter:in, Mentor:in oder Digital Champion. Praxisnahe Schulungsformate, in denen Teilnehmende selbst üben, sind ein Plus.

  • Glaubwürdigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke, um Gruppen von 10 bis 15 Pflegekräften auch unter Zeitdruck zu begeistern und zu motivieren.

  • Begeisterung für Technologie, die die Pflege leichter macht, und Geduld, Kolleg:innen durch Veränderungen zu begleiten.

  • Fließend Deutsch (C2) und die Bereitschaft, 2 bis 3 Mal pro Woche für TTA-Schulungen vor Ort zu reisen.

🌱 Gemeinsam wachsen – Das erwartet dich bei voize

  • Eine neue berufliche Perspektive: Entwickle dich außerhalb der klassischen Pflegelaufbahn weiter, ohne der Pflege den Rücken zu kehren.

  • Keine Schicht-, Nacht- oder Wochenenddienste: Gestalte deinen Alltag außerhalb des klassischen Schichtsystems.

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Erfahrene Trainer:innen begleiten dich bei deinem Einstieg.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und gestaltest Schulungen und Prozesse aktiv mit.

✨ Bereit für ein Gespräch? Jetzt bewerben!

We are looking for a Propellant Quality Control Engineer to ensure the quality, consistency, and traceability of the materials and processes used to manufacture our solid propellants. Working closely with the Lead Propellant Manager, laboratory technicians, propulsion engineers, manufacturing, and suppliers, you will define and execute quality-control activities from incoming raw materials through to finished propellant.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical judgement with a disciplined approach to measurement, documentation, investigation, and process control. Your work will help ensure that propellant development and production remain safe, repeatable, and aligned with the required performance standards.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and perform quality-control checks for raw materials, intermediate products, and finished propellant.

  • Develop and maintain inspection plans, test methods, acceptance criteria, sampling requirements, and quality records.

  • Review laboratory and production data to identify trends, variation, out-of-specification results, and emerging process issues.

  • Lead or support investigations into non-conformances, deviations, material issues, and unexpected test results.

  • Maintain clear traceability of materials, batches, samples, equipment, results, and technical decisions.

  • Work with the Lead Propellant Manager and manufacturing teams to improve process capability, measurement quality, and production consistency.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in quality control, quality engineering, laboratory testing, or process control within a chemical, aerospace, manufacturing, or other regulated environment.

  • A degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Strong understanding of measurement systems, test methods, sampling, data review, and technical documentation.

  • Experience investigating non-conformances, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions.

  • A methodical and detail-oriented approach to safety, traceability, data integrity, and compliance.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with laboratory, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams.

Desirable experience

  • Solid rocket propellants, energetic materials, Elastomers, polymers, binders, oxidisers, metallic fuels, or catalysts.

  • Propellant or chemical-material characterisation, including thermal, mechanical, rheological, chemical, or burn-rate testing.

  • Incoming-material inspection, supplier quality, batch release, certificate-of-analysis review, or material qualification.

  • Statistical process control, measurement-system analysis, capability studies, trend analysis, or uncertainty assessment.

  • Experience with hazardous chemicals, explosives, regulated materials, or formal laboratory and manufacturing quality systems.

  • Python, MATLAB, laboratory information systems, electronic records, or other tools for quality and test-data analysis.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

Deine Rolle

Du entwickelst das HubSpot-Setup von LIQID weiter: Du baust Workflows, Automationen und Integrationen, die Sales und Relationship Management im Tagesgeschäft unterstützen und machst aus den Daten im System ein Reporting, auf das sich Team und Führung verlassen können.

Den laufenden Betrieb der Plattform hältst du dabei stabil: Berechtigungen, Lizenzen, Datenqualität, Dokumentation. Der Schwerpunkt deiner Arbeit liegt jedoch auf dem Bauen, nicht auf dem Verwalten.

System und Team

HubSpot Sales Hub und Service Hub sind in diesem Jahr frisch implementiert. Du triffst also kein fertiges System an, das verwaltet werden will, sondern eine Plattform im Aufbau. Entsprechend groß sind der Gestaltungsspielraum und die Verantwortung für saubere Grundlagen.

Du berichtest an den Lead Revenue Operations und arbeitest eng mit Sales und Relationship Management zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Baue Workflows, Sequences, Pipelines und Lead Routing in HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub und Service Hub: von der Verteilung eingehender Leads über Meeting-Links bis zu automatischen Aufgaben in Sales und Relationship Management.

  • Verbinde HubSpot mit dem übrigen TechStack, also Aircall, Google Workspace, Notion und Slack, über native Connectoren, APIs, Webhooks oder Automatisierungstools. Entwickle das Toolstack sinnvoll weiter.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Arbeit mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren CRM wie Salesforce.

  • HubSpot-Zertifizierungen

  • Erfahrung mit gängigen Automatisierungslösungen wie n8n, zapier oder make.com

  • Erfahrung in einem regulierten Umfeld, etwa Finanzdienstleistungen

  • Grundkenntnisse in JavaScript oder Python für Custom-Code-Actions

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

Anyone can train a model in a notebook these days. Getting it into production, keeping it accurate month after month and turning its output into decisions people actually make is a different story. That's the job.

For a renowned automotive manufacturer in Munich, we are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who builds models that matter for a premium brand. You work with structured and unstructured data, take models all the way into production and make sure they keep delivering. Your results shape strategic decisions and the experience of customers who expect nothing less than premium.

What makes this role different

You don't build models that end up in a slide deck. You own them end to end, from the raw data to the deployed model to the insight a decision maker acts on. One client, one location, one team in Munich, with direct access to the people who use your work.

And you are the person who brings machine learning into the business. You explain what a model can and cannot do, teach colleagues how to use it and help them ask better questions of their data.

Degree or not, what counts is what you have built. If you have a proven track record of shipping machine learning applications, for example in open source, that is as valuable to us as a degree.

The goal is ambitious. Move machine learning out of experiments and into the decisions a premium brand makes every day, from strategy to the experience of its customers.

What you will do

  • Develop and implement machine learning models for premium automotive applications
  • Collect, clean and prepare structured and unstructured data so your models are built on something solid
  • Deploy models to production, monitor them and keep them performing over time
  • Turn results into clear insights that support strategic decisions and enhance the customer experience
  • Document your work and teach others how machine learning and AI can be used in their daily business

What you bring

  • A degree in a technical field with a strong focus on machine learning, or a proven track record of building machine learning applications, for example in open source projects
  • Outstanding Python skills and a real appreciation for clean, well documented code
  • Experience developing and running applications in the cloud
  • Hands-on experience taking models into production and monitoring them, ideally with MLOps tools
  • A genuine passion for machine learning and AI and their potential in real business applications
  • The ability to explain a complex topic to a manager in the morning and dig into a data pipeline in the afternoon
  • Fluent English; German is a plus, but not a must

You'll stand out if you have shipped models that are used in day-to-day business, maintained or contributed to open source machine learning projects, or worked with automotive or industrial data.

The essentials

Start on 1 February 2027 in Munich, 35 hours per week, with an engagement until the end of 2027. You will be employed by advanced engineering GmbH and work directly with our client's project team.

As a leading IT security solutions provider, we are looking for a highly motivated, commercially driven and transformational Director Distribution EMEA Central to lead our distribution business across approximately 20 countries, with a primary focus on the DACH region (Germany, Austria and Switzerland).

This is a senior leadership role with end-to-end responsibility for the performance, development and transformation of our distribution ecosystem across EMEA Central. The Director will lead and develop a Distribution-Team and work closely with Sales, Channel, Marketing, Operations and Finance to ensure that distribution effectively supports our overall go-to-market strategy.

The role goes beyond traditional distributor relationship management. It requires a strong focus on profitable growth, operational excellence, scalable partner activation and the continued transformation of distribution towards cloud, MSP/MSSP, managed services and subscription-based business models. This reflects a broader cybersecurity channel shift toward managed services, platformization and resilience-led solutions.

 

What You'll Do

  • Oversee the development and execution of distribution strategies across approximately 20 countries, with a primary focus on the DACH region. Build and strengthen strategic distributor relationships, ensuring alignment with company objectives and driving growth across the Sophos cybersecurity portfolio.

  • Drive MSP distribution, cloud marketplace adoption and recurring business models as integral elements of the overall channel and distribution strategy.

  • Own the strategic relationship with key distributors, including joint business planning, executive alignment, performance management and growth initiatives.

  • Maintain a detailed understanding of distributors’ businesses, including market dynamics, pain points, investment priorities, profitability drivers and growth opportunities.

  • Manage relevant financial and credit topics in close collaboration with Finance, ensuring sustainable and profitable distributor relationships.

  • Develop short-, medium- and long-term joint business plans with distributors, including clear objectives, growth initiatives and accurate forecasts.

  • Proactively address challenges and resistance related to transformation and change initiatives.

  • Establish an open feedback and continuous-improvement culture that supports both team development and organizational transformation.

  • Execute Distribution and Channel Go-to-Market strategies in alignment with regional and corporate priorities.

  • Set clear objectives for team members, monitor performance against agreed KPIs, OKRs and business targets, and ensure formal performance and development reviews are conducted.


What You'll Bring


Required:

  • Several years' of experience in distribution account management, channel management or sales leadership, preferably in the IT security industry

  • Experience developing business plans

  • Experience developing and monitoring business and opportunity plans

  • Broad business background, including knowledge of financial, marketing and sales concepts

  • Ability to engage with all levels of an organisation to achieve strategic and tactical objectives

  • Excellent relationship management skills and the ability to resolve conflicts

  • Understanding of financial management and business investment planning

  • Ability to learn quickly and adopt new approaches and techniques

  • Ability to understand the technical background of our solutions

  • Ability to understand partners’ business models

  • Knowledge of software channel ecosystems in the territory

  • Strong presentation skills, communication and interpersonal skills

  • Strong motivational skills

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Willingness to travel extensively across the EMEA Central region to engage with distributors, partners and internal stakeholders.

We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

As Orbem’s appointed Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, you are responsible for occupational health and safety at all Orbem sites and client installations, from laboratories and MRI environments to the workshop. You are the subject-matter expert Orbem relies on for the hard safety calls: you set the standards, build the systems behind them and lead the safety projects that matter most. You work with a high degree of autonomy. Your impact comes from technical depth, influence and mentoring. You decide independently on risk assessment methods, technical standards and corrective actions, align with management on measures with high cost or cross-team impact, and escalate imminent dangers and legal non-compliance early.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Legal Occupational Safety: You perform all duties of a designated occupational safety specialist under § 7 ASiG and ensure compliance with the relevant regulations (ArbSchG, GefStoffV, BioStoffV, StrlSchG, ArbStättV).

  • Safety Strategy & Systems: You own Orbem’s cross-functional OHS: risk assessments, incident management and compliance frameworks, including a legal register, standards, templates and escalation paths.

  • Subject-Matter Expertise: You are the key expert for safety in laboratory and MRI environments (magnetic fields, hazardous and biological substances) and set the standard for quality in this area.

  • Projects: You lead complex, cross-functional safety projects, such as new labs and build-outs, and coordinate contractor safety.

  • Incidents & Root Cause Analysis: You investigate incidents and near-misses, run root cause analyses and follow every corrective action through to closure.

  • Training & Mentoring: You build the training and instruction programme, document knowledge, give internal talks and mentor colleagues and the safety contacts in the teams.

  • ESG: Support the team with knowledge, advice and guidance on environmental and sustainability topics, and help develop how ESG fits into Orbem as the topic grows.

  • Authorities & Audits: You are the contact for authorities, auditors and external partners on specialist matters.

Your responsibilities include:

Keeping Orbem compliant with German occupational health and safety law, from risk assessments and training to incident follow-up and contact with authorities. You will also be focusing on the development of the OHS function at Orbem.

Your Experience and Skills

  • You hold the Sifa qualification under § 7 ASiG, on top of a degree in engineering, safety engineering or natural sciences, occupational health & safety or a related discipline.

  • 6+ years of experience in occupational health and safety, with proven depth

  • Strong knowledge of German regulations (ArbSchG, ArbStättV, GefStoffV, BetrSichV, BioStoffV,).

  • You have worked in laboratory or high-tech environments. If MRI and magnetic field safety is new to you, we will help you build that side.

  • A track record of leading complex, cross-functional safety projects and of setting standards and building systems, not only applying them.

  • You drive corrective actions to closure and win buy-in, not just the technical argument.

  • You have the standing to give independent advice and hold your position with management, engineers, and scientists, while staying pragmatic.

  • You share what you know: you document, train and mentor instead of becoming a single point of failure.

  • Although you work locally, you think across locations and see exchanges with colleagues at other sites as an opportunity to grow, both virtually and through occasional business trips.

  • Excellent communication in German (C1+) & English (B2+).

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Knowledge of electrical safety (VDE standards, DGUV Vorschrift 3)

  • Strong knowledge of StrlSchG

  • Experience with facilities in a deep-tech or high-tech environment.

  • Skilled at interpreting and adapting regulatory frameworks to ensure compliance in new geographical regions,

  • Experience with ESG topics such as sustainability reporting or a carbon footprint.

  • Knowledge of US requirements (OSHA)

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.
