Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own the delivery of scoped customer implementations and help turn real-world business needs into production-grade agentic automation solutions. You’ll partner closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to design, build, integrate, and iterate on AI-enabled workflows, balancing speed, reliability, and maintainability. You’ll contribute practical field insights back to the organization, helping refine solution patterns, reusable assets, and implementation playbooks.

Unlike traditional software engineers who build a single product for many customers, FDEs ship tailored solutions directly in customer environments, making the platform real for specific business processes and systems. You’ll operate with increasing independence, drive execution on well-defined workstreams, and collaborate with senior FDEs and product teams to align with broader technical direction.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Design and build AI-driven workflows, agents, and automations, aligned with UiPath's architecture and platform standards without requiring regular guidance.

  • Build AI Agents using UiPath technologies, including Maestro or Agent Builder

  • Apply practical prompt engineering skills to reliably guide agent behavior and understand model tradeoffs (capability, latency, cost) when selecting LLM providers for customer use cases.

  • Extend platform functionality using APIs, SDKs, and connectors to address unique customer requirements.

  • Debug across systems including AI inference, data pipelines, orchestration layers, and integration points, resolving most issues independently.

  • Contribute to internal libraries, reusable components, or frameworks that enhance consistency across customer deployments.

  • Anticipate delivery risks and communicate blockers, delays, and scope issues proactively to teammates and stakeholders.

  • Use telemetry, insights, and traces to identify optimization opportunities and failure patterns independently.

 

What you'll bring to the team

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent) delivering production software.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (or similar modern languages).

  • Experience building and shipping integrations using APIs and working with cloud services or enterprise systems.

  • Comfort operating in customer-facing environments with strong written and verbal communication.

  • Ability to independently drive scoped projects, manage risks, and deliver against deadlines.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed.

 

Our core principles

  • Customer Centric: Stay close to customer users and stakeholders; anchor decisions in outcomes, adoption, and long-term success.

  • Breaking Silos: Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customer teams to unblock delivery and align on the right solution.

  • Improving Agility: Prototype, test, ship, observe, and iterate—treat deployments and feedback loops as the fastest way to learn.

  • Dealing with Ambiguity: Make progress with incomplete information; clarify requirements through discovery, iteration, and pragmatic tradeoffs.

  • Building Focus: Prioritize the highest-impact workstreams, manage scope actively, and deliver durable solutions that customers can run and evolve.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Who you are

Location: Paris, France (4 days onsite per week)

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

Salary: €100,000 – €120,000 gross/year

About the Opportunity

We are partnering with a leading European financial market infrastructure group to build a new Digital Assets division, focused on tokenisation and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT).

The mission is to develop next-generation financial infrastructure, launch innovative digital asset products for institutional and retail clients, and bridge traditional finance (TradFi) with decentralised finance (DeFi).

This is a unique founding-style leadership opportunity within an established, highly regulated financial institution. You will have the opportunity to shape the technical vision, own the architecture, and build foundational technology from the ground up.

The Mission

You will lead the architecture of the organisation's first tokenised financial products, covering two major initiatives:

  • Tokenised Securities Platform: Building an issuance, trading and settlement platform for equities, ETFs and bonds, featuring 24/7 trading, fractional ownership and on-chain Delivery-versus-Payment (DvP) settlement.
  • Tokenised Collateral Management Platform: Enabling real-time repo transactions, CCP margin eligibility and DeFi distribution of government bonds through regulated lending environments.

Your responsibility is to translate these strategic initiatives into secure, scalable and auditable technical architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end architecture for digital asset solutions, integrating DLT with traditional financial market infrastructure, including trading, clearing, settlement, custody and CSD.
  • Design cross-chain architectures across permissioned networks (Hyperledger Besu, Canton Network) and public blockchains (Ethereum/L2).
  • Define on-chain compliance frameworks, including ERC-3643/T-REX token standards, KYC-whitelisted wallets, AML screening and transaction reporting.
  • Architect institutional custody and key management solutions using MPC technologies such as Fireblocks and Taurus.
  • Establish engineering standards covering code quality, architecture reviews, testing and secure-by-design development.
  • Lead threat modelling and security architecture for high-value financial systems.
  • Drive build-versus-buy decisions across blockchain infrastructure, custody and audit solutions.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Legal, Regulatory, Clearing and CSD stakeholders.
  • Remain hands-on with critical technical components and high-risk incidents.
  • Build and develop the engineering team as the platform transitions from development to production.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, including at least 3 years working on DLT or blockchain projects.
  • Strong expertise in distributed systems and blockchain architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with EVM and permissioned blockchain networks such as Canton or Hyperledger Besu.
  • Knowledge of regulated security token standards, particularly ERC-3643/T-REX or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of smart contract security, cross-chain risks and on-chain compliance.
  • Experience designing secure, highly available financial systems operating 24/7.
  • Working knowledge of capital markets infrastructure, including DvP, CSD, CCP and settlement processes.
  • Strong leadership skills with a player-coach mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

AI Engineering Skills (Required)

  • Experience defining AI-augmented software development workflows using coding assistants, smart contract scaffolding and AI-generated test suites.
  • Ability to establish governance and security guardrails for AI-assisted code, including code reviews, secret management and licence/provenance checks.
  • Experience evaluating AI development tools and identifying practical productivity improvements.
  • Understanding of AI-powered product capabilities such as anomaly detection and operational triage, including associated risk controls.

Why Join?

  • Take ownership of the architecture for a major digital asset infrastructure initiative.
  • Build innovative tokenisation products at the intersection of TradFi and DeFi.
  • Work within an established European financial institution while enjoying the autonomy of a zero-to-one project.
  • Influence strategic technology decisions and shape the future engineering team.

Important: Candidates must be willing to work onsite in Paris, France, 4 days per week.

Salary: €100K–€120K gross annually.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, VO2 Group recherche un Chef de projet delivery pour intervenir sur une application iOS de Clienteling, destinée aux conseillers de vente en magasin afin d’optimiser et de personnaliser la relation client.

Vos missions


Pilotage du delivery

  • Anticiper les besoins en staffing, gérer la disponibilité des équipes et préparer l’onboarding des nouveaux arrivants.


Gestion budgétaire, reporting et risques

  • Piloter le budget, suivre le consommé et le reste à faire, et assurer la
    facturation mensuelle.
  • Anticiper les écarts budgétaires et proposer des solutions adaptées : renfort, avenant ou ajustement du périmètre.

    contractuels.

  • Maintenir une documentation projet à jour afin de garantir la continuité

  • Être l’interlocuteur unique et de confiance du client, en assurant une

  • Communiquer les difficultés en amont et proposer des solutions concrètes.
  • Négocier le périmètre, arbitrer les priorités et savoir challenger les demandes

  • Être force de proposition sur les méthodes de travail, les améliorations et les nouvelles initiatives.
  • Garantir un haut niveau d’exigence, de précision et de qualité de service.

Expérience et compétences

  • Minimum 5 ans d’expérience, dont 3 ans en pilotage de projets face à un client, idéalement en ESN ou en agence.
  • Expérience avérée en gestion budgétaire et facturation de projet.
  • Bonne culture technique (applications mobiles iOS, Salesforce, API),
    permettant de comprendre les enjeux et de challenger les équipes techniques.
  • Maîtrise des méthodologies agiles (Scrum) et de Jira.
  • Une expérience dans le secteur du luxe ou du retail constitue un véritable atout.
  • Anglais courant.


Savoir-être

  •  Fort sens des responsabilités (ownership), autonomie, engagement, rigueur, esprit d’analyse et capacité de priorisation.
  • Curiosité métier et technique, proactivité, orientation solutions et capacité à gérer la pression dans la durée.

L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue.  En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art.
L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !

Présentation Theodo Data & AI
 
Avec ses clients, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Pour servir nos clients à chaque étape du cycle de vie de leurs produits, nous avons développé des entités expertes en Design, Web, Mobile, Data et IA, Cloud, Serverless. Pour répondre aux enjeux spécifiques de certains secteurs, nous avons également mis en place des entités spécialisées en retail et ecommerce, services financiers, secteur public, systèmes et services de santé.
Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art.
 
🧐 Contexte du recrutement
Cette année, la majorité de notre croissance a été réalisée grâce à l'activation de grands comptes stratégiques. Nous échangeons avec des décideurs dont les enjeux data sont stratégiques pour le développement de leurs entreprises.
 
Pour accompagner le développement rapide de Sicara, nous cherchons un Chief of Staff qui sera le le bras droit des dirigeants et leur représentant auprès des équipes.
 
🎯 Tes missions
Ton objectif est de démultiplier l'impact des dirigeants en apportant un appui opérationnel et stratégique. Tu es aussi le garant de la bonne organisation de l'équipe de direction.
 
1) Construire la stratégie de l'entreprise avec les dirigeants (CEO / CTO) :
- définition de la stratégie à 12 mois (vision, leviers de croissance,...)
- construction de strategic review annuelle
 
2) Aider les dirigeants à faire réussir la stratégie de manière opérationnelle :
- priorisation des sujets : organiser et leader le weekly dirigeants, organiser l'agenda
- responsable des moments clés de l'équipe de direction : weekly meeting, organisation d’après-midis et de week-ends strat
- diffusion de la vision à l'ensemble des équipes via la production des supports de communication interne : monthly meeting, keynote semestrielle,…
 
3) Faire atterrir les chantiers
- identification des chantiers stratégiques de Theodo Data IA
- suivi et accompagnement des responsables
 
4) Piloter un projet niveau du groupe
- par exemple : mise en place d’un SIRH
 
🚀 Tes perspectives
En passant par le rôle de Chief of Staff, tu auras accès au coeur du réacteur de Sicara, tu comprendras de l’intérieur comment penser et déployer opérationellement une stratégie et faire réussir une boîte. Tu développeras ton réseau de C-levels au sein du startup studio M33 en travaillant sur des sujets clés. Le rôle vise à propulser sur des rôles de direction opérationnel ou financier par la suite.
 
🙌 Profil recherché
Tu as entre 3 et 6 ans d’expérience, dont une expérience significative en conseil

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit, and which carries cargo – and potentially humans in the long run. We are also developing different types of propulsion systems to power our future vehicles and missions. As a talented Test Development Engineer, you will be part of the team that is responsible for the development of test facilities for our future propulsion systems.


Key Responsibilities / Tasks:

In your capacity as a Test Development Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties may include:

  • Synthesise test bench requirements from user and operator needs and plan required verification methods and tests.

  • Translate engine test objectives and stakeholder needs into facility-level functional and performance requirements.

  • Perform technical trade-offs to determine the best choice of hardware, software, equipment, component, location etc for various test facilities.

  • Perform risk assessment analyses for future tests and developing mitigation actions to ensure personnel and hardware safety.

  • Provide technical inputs to cost, schedule, procurement, commissioning, maintainability, and facility acceptance planning.

  • Prepare and maintain P&IDs of test facilities based on test bench requirements and selecting components.

  • Undertaking preliminary design of the ground support equipment with minimal oversight.

  • Undertake hazard assessments of the test facility design (FMEA and HAZOPs) to determine if any additional changes to the design are required.

  • Work with the current test bench team to coordinate end-to-end activities of the development of test facilities including design, reviews, manufacturing, installation, commissioning, test operations, ongoing upgrades and maintenance.

  • Work with procurement, AIT and design teams during the development of test facilities to find the right balance of technical solutions, cost and lead time.

  • Presenting findings to team members and participating in design reviews and project discussions.


What we would love to see from you:

  • Bachelor's, master's or PhD in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field (Master’s and above preferred).

  • 2–5 years of experience in propulsion, test facility development, experimental engineering, or a related field.

    • Practical experience in the design, development, commissioning, or operation of test facilities, preferably for rocket propulsion systems.

    • Experience in test facility design for cryogenic propulsion systems is highly desirable. Relevant experience with other cryogenic or high-pressure fluid systems will also be considered.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret technical data, challenge assumptions, and make evidence-based engineering recommendations.

  • Proven ability to work autonomously on assigned technical topics while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary engineering team.

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

As an early member of the team, you will shape how we recruit scientists at Mistral and build the foundations to scale it.

What You Will Do

  • Source and engage world-class researchers through direct outreach, academic networks, publications, open-source contributions, and the international conference circuit (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).

  • Build a deep understanding of our research areas and the wider AI research landscape, so you can hold credible conversations with scientists about their work and our research direction.

  • Partner with research leads and hiring managers to define role profiles, calibrate seniority, and align on what "exceptional" looks like for each research position.

  • Design and run interview processes adapted to research hiring, including research talks, paper discussions, technical deep dives, and applied problem-solving, while keeping them rigorous and respectful of candidates' time.

  • Own the candidate journey from first contact to signed offer, with particular care for passive candidates, senior researchers, and academics weighing a move from a lab or university.

  • Build pipelines early: PhD and postdoc talent, research interns and residents, and relationships with leading universities, labs, and research communities.

  • Navigate the complexity of international research hiring, including relocation, work authorization, and offer structure, in coordination with People Ops and Legal.

  • Advise on compensation, equity, and research-specific considerations (publication policy, research freedom, compute access) to craft compelling, competitive offers.

  • Use data to track pipeline health, conversion, time-to-hire, and market trends, and use those insights to refine our approach.

  • Build scalable systems, documentation, and best practices to support rapid growth in the research organization.

  • Act as an ambassador for Mistral's research culture, internally and externally.

  • Embrace hybrid work, with regular onsite collaboration in Paris to strengthen team connections.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience: 3+ years in recruiting in tech, ideally with experience in AI/ML, deep tech, or research-intensive environments.

  • Research hiring expertise: A track record of closing research scientists, research engineers, or PhD-level candidates in competitive markets, and the ability to evaluate profiles beyond keywords (publication record, research impact, trajectory).

  • Scientific fluency: Solid understanding of the AI/ML research landscape and the curiosity to keep learning. You can discuss a candidate's work with them and with our researchers.

  • Market savvy: Ability to own and execute searches independently in highly competitive talent landscapes, including passive and senior candidates.

  • Stakeholder influence: Ability to advise and align research leaders and senior scientists with credibility and diplomacy.

  • Data-driven mindset: Skilled at analyzing metrics to solve problems and optimize recruitment processes.

  • Global perspective: Experience with international hiring (including relocation and visa considerations) and fluent English communication. French is a plus.

  • Hands-on execution: Capable of balancing strategy with operational excellence, staying organized and disciplined.

  • Tool proficiency: Familiarity with modern ATS (e.g. Ashby), LinkedIn search, scheduling (e.g. Modernloop), and AI-driven productivity tools is a plus. Experience sourcing via Google Scholar, arXiv, GitHub, or Semantic Scholar is a strong plus.

Who You Are

These aren't buzzwords. They reflect what we look for in the people we hire, and what we have seen make the difference in this role.

  • Curious by nature. You learn constantly, and you dig into new research areas, tools and ways of working because you want to, not because you have to.

  • At home in pace and ambiguity. You thrive when things move fast and the path isn't clear, and you turn chaos into a clean state.

  • A proactive doer. You are highly efficient, you don't wait to be asked, and you turn ideas into real-life results.

  • A builder of better recruitment. You enjoy partnering with the HRBP team to constantly improve how we recruit.

The mission

You will be the reference point for the most complex hardware interventions across our sites.

Mistral's compute is our largest investment and the foundation of frontier AI in Europe. As a Senior Data Center Hardware Engineer, you own the interventions that require the highest level of technical expertise: multi-node failures in production, full-rack deployments of GPU-dense systems, and vendor escalations where you speak as the technical authority for our sites.

You'll work end-to-end — compute, storage, interconnect, power and cooling interfaces — across our data center footprint, raising the bar on reliability as our capacity grows. This is a hands-on senior IC role: deep technical leadership and mentorship, no direct line management.

Location: Based at one of our data centers in the Paris region, with occasional visits to our other sites as needed.

 

What you'll do

  • Lead complex interventions — vendor-level and multi-node operations in production: full rack builds and bring-up, GPU-dense platform deployment (H100/H200-class and next-gen, including liquid-cooled racks), intricate recabling, post-restart diagnosis. You own the plan, the risk assessment, and the rollback.

  • Own vendor management — coordinate repairs, part replacements and escalations directly with hardware vendors; hold them to their SLAs; drive proactive fixes from failure trends.

  • Diagnose at depth — correlate symptoms across compute, storage, interconnect and cooling; read BMC/IPMI consoles, OS logs and crash dumps; methodical root-cause analysis that ends in concrete corrective actions.

  • Deploy and validate — structured bring-up and validation of new racks and platforms; work with networking and infrastructure teams to take installations from delivery to production-ready.

  • Lift the team — mentor and pair with L1–L3 engineers on live operations; turn your knowledge into SOPs, checklists and training material; propose and build small automation (Python/Bash) to shorten MTTR.

  • Work the facility interface — partner with critical facilities/engineering ops on power, cooling (air and liquid), PDU and monitoring (BMS/EPMS) boundaries; enforce ESD/LOTO/PPE and audit-ready change discipline everywhere.

  • Own spares & reliability — plan spares strategy, track fleet failure trends, and run proactive vendor actions before incidents happen.

 

About you

  • 6+ years in data center / server hardware or L2/L3 hardware support, including complex hands-on work in production environments (HPC/AI/cloud at scale strongly preferred).

  • End-to-end hardware expertise: CPU/memory/PCIe (incl. accelerators), NICs, PSUs, drives, network, power and cooling interfaces (DLC included); strong judgment on when and how to escalate.

  • Diagnostics depth: confident with BMC/IPMI logs, Linux logs and CLI checks; structured root-cause analysis.

  • Deployment experience: you've taken racks from delivery to production, with concrete examples to show for it.

  • Vendor fluency: you've managed hardware vendors — RMAs, field replacements, escalations — to concrete outcomes.

  • Impeccable safety and discipline: ESD/LOTO/PPE without exception; clean, labeled, auditable work.

  • Communication & mentoring: clear status updates and handovers; able to coach engineers during live incidents with composure.

  • Mobility: willing to visit our other sites in the Paris region as needed.

 

Nice to have

  • GPU-dense platform experience: NVIDIA H-series (H100/H200) or GB-series rack deployments.

  • High-speed interconnects (InfiniBand/RoCE), RAID/storage (NVMe/SAS/SATA), vendor tooling (iDRAC/iLO/IPMI).

Wir sind ein Team aus Unternehmer:innen, Psycholog:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das Freude zurück in die Therapie bringt. Bei PlaynVoice gestalten wir die psychische Gesundheitsversorgung neu, indem wir KI mit klinischer Expertise verbinden und Dokumentation mühelos machen.

Unser AI-Scribe wird heute von rund 700 Therapeut:innen sowie von Institutionen in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Österreich genutzt. Jeden Monat erstellen wir über 30.000 Patientennotizen. In einer Pilotstudie mit dem Psychiatriezentrum Münsingen (PZM) wurde die Dokumentationszeit um 50% reduziert, bei einer Patientenakzeptanz von 97%. PlaynVoice ist vollständig auf Französisch verfügbar, und erste Praxen in der Romandie arbeiten bereits damit.

Wir suchen eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die diesen Markt mit uns aufbaut.

Positionsübersicht

  • Pensum: 80–100%

  • Standort: Zürich, hybrid (min. 2 Tage vor Ort)

  • Marktfokus: Romandie

  • Startdatum: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Aufgaben

In der Deutschschweiz haben wir den Product-Market-Fit erreicht – jetzt bringen wir PlaynVoice in die Romandie. Du bist dort unsere zentrale Person: du eröffnest Gespräche, qualifizierst Chancen und führst Deals bis zum Abschluss.

  • Neukund:innen gewinnen: Du kontaktierst Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen und Praxisinhaber:innen per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und kombinierst KI-Tools mit bewährten Kanälen.

  • Präsentieren & abschliessen: Du zeigst in Demos, wie der AI-Scribe den Praxisalltag verändert, beantwortest Fragen, räumst Hindernisse aus dem Weg und führst Interessent:innen bis zur Unterschrift.

  • Kund:innen betreuen: Du begleitest bestehende Praxen in der Romandie und baust sie zu Referenzen aus.

  • Playbook übertragen: Du überträgst unser bewährtes Sales-Playbook auf die Romandie und entwickelst es auf Französisch weiter.

Was du mitbringst

  • 1–2 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder in einer kundennahen Rolle.

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du arbeitest dich rasch in Neues ein und lernst aus jedem Gespräch.

  • Du telefonierst gerne, hörst gut zu und lässt dich von einem Nein nicht aus der Bahn werfen.

  • Echtes Interesse am Gesundheitswesen – du verstehst, wer unsere Kund:innen sind und warum ihre Arbeit wichtig ist.

  • Ownership: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Pipeline und deine Ziele.

  • Sprachen: Französisch verhandlungssicher, gute Deutschkenntnisse und sicheres Englisch (unsere Team-Meetings finden auf Englisch statt).

Im Idealfall

  • Du verstehst Schweizerdeutsch – das hilft dir beim Demo-Shadowing mit unserem Sales-Team.

  • Du bist auch auf Deutsch verhandlungssicher und schliesst Deals in der Deutschschweiz ab.

  • Du hast erste Erfahrung mit B2B-SaaS oder Sales-Tools (CRM, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

  • Du hast einen persönlichen Bezug zum Gesundheitswesen – z.B. durch Studium, Familie oder Ehrenamt.

Perspektive & Benefits

  • Mit dem Markt wachsen: Du startest mit Einzelpraxen und entwickelst dich hin zu Gruppenpraxen und Institutionen in der Romandie.

  • Von einem eingespielten Team lernen: Vier Sales-Kolleg:innen in der Deutschschweiz und die Gründer – auch auf Französisch – teilen ihr Wissen mit dir.

  • Arbeite an einem Produkt, das den Alltag von Psychotherapeut:innen und Psychiater:innen spürbar verbessert – mit messbarem Impact.

  • Attraktives Vergütungsmodell mit Grundgehalt und ungedeckelter variabler Komponente, plus Mitarbeiterbeteiligung (Equity).

  • Monatliche Team-Lunches, regelmässige Social Events (z.B. Windkanal oder Europa-Park) und ein jährliches Offsite (zuletzt in Lissabon).

Bitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf sowie 5–10 Sätze dazu, warum du bei PlaynVoice arbeiten möchtest – auf Französisch oder Deutsch. Wir lesen jede Bewerbung persönlich. Bewerbungen ohne individuelle Begründung können wir nicht berücksichtigen.

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.


Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.


About the role
The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models.
 
As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers.
 
We are looking for a motivated student or recent graduate with a background in computer science, data science or a related field and a solid foundation in Python and data processing, available to start in early 2027. 

What you will do

Data pipeline

  • Get to know how data is collected, stored, processed and labelled at Gravis today, map the current data flows, and suggest ways to improve them

  • Explore the data pipeline and orchestration tools available today (e.g., Dagster, Flyte, Argo Workflows, Airflow, Ray Data) and compare them against our requirements: data volume, multimodal sensor data, CPU and GPU processing steps, reproducibility and ease of use

  • Help build small prototypes of the most promising options and test them on real fleet data, from raw machine recordings to training-ready datasets

  • Work with our infrastructure team to set up the chosen pipeline on Kubernetes, so that it runs reliably on our on-premise and cloud clusters

  • Help add data versioning, quality checks, lineage and monitoring, so that engineers can trust every dataset and trace where it came from

    • Collaboration and sharing

  • Write up the trade-offs and present your recommendation to the team

  • Document the pipeline and help ML and robotics engineers start using it


    • What we're looking for

    We recognise that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.

    Core qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Master's programme in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field in a Swiss university 

  • Solid Python skills and hands-on experience with data pipelines or data-heavy applications, from coursework, a thesis, side projects or a previous internship

  • Good working knowledge of data processing fundamentals: batch and streaming processing, columnar file formats (e.g., Parquet), and SQL databases

  • Familiarity with Docker and working in a Linux environment

  • Comfortable with open-ended problems where the answer is not known yet, and able to compare technical options and explain your reasoning, both in writing and in front of a team

    • Nice to have

  • Experience with a workflow orchestrator (e.g., Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, Flyte, Argo Workflows)

  • Experience with distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Ray, Spark, Dask)

  • Experience with Kubernetes

  • Experience working with robotics or sensor data (point clouds, camera streams, time-series data) and formats such as ROS bags or MCAP

  • Experience with data versioning or dataset management tools (e.g., DVC, lakeFS)


    • This role is a great fit if…

  • You are eager to apply your academic knowledge to real-world problems, and to see your work having an impact on actual machines

  • You want to contribute to a foundational data pipeline that helps our machines improve faster

  • You thrive in a hands-on environment where you learn new tools by trying them out on real data

  • You are curious about machine learning and about how training datasets are built

  • You value a collaborative culture built on thoughtful design, creative problem-solving, mutual respect, and pragmatism

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team, and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics.

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

About AMINI

AMINI advises, designs, and delivers across strategy, infrastructure, and AI. We work directly with clients on technology decisions, architecture, projects, and AI implementations - and we ship our own products alongside client work (andock.app, mrkr.app, it-provider.ch, and others).

We’re an ambitious team based in Zug and Zurich - this is your chance to build something remarkable together with a leading edge team.

The Role

We’re looking for an AI-Native Design Engineer who treats interfaces as a craft - the place where business intent, technical constraints, and usability meet.

You’ll own the design and frontend implementation of experiences across our own products and selected client projects. This is not a pure design role and not a pure engineering role. It’s for someone who moves fluidly between both and ships things that feel considered, polished, and inevitable. Design taste is obviously a must in this role.

You’ll work closely with architects, solution engineers, and client teams. You’ll have real ownership and a direct path from idea to production.

  • Design and build production interfaces for our products and client solutions (AI tools, agent interfaces, dashboards, internal systems, analytics products, etc.).

data.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing advanced autonomous systems that need to fly close to the ground, over varied terrain and through cluttered environments such as forests and built-up areas, where there is very little margin for error.

Even a carefully prepared flight plan must be backed by onboard sensing, ready to react to terrain variations and unexpected obstacles. We are building this capability and exploring hybrid approaches that combine planning and real-time reaction.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to explore, develop and evaluate terrain-following and collision-avoidance methods based primarily on onboard sensors, enabling safe low-altitude flight.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Conduct a comprehensive review of existing terrain-following approaches and obstacle-avoidance

  • Algorithm Implementation: Develop and implement various algorithms based on the literature review and project requirements using simulated and real-world flight data.

  • Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance, safety margins and computational overhead of the developed algorithms.

  • Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

  • Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results, and conclusions.

  • Flight Tests Participation: Actively participate in flight test sessions to gather real-world data and validate the effectiveness of the developed algorithms in operational conditions. Contribute to real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record in robotics, aerospace engineering, automatic control, applied mathematics or a related field. Knowledge of perception, guidance or motion planning is a strong plus.

  • Technical Skills: Solid foundation in sensor fusion and/or guidance and control. Experience with lidar or vision processing, terrain data or drones is a major plus.

  • Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

data.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As a Flight Control Intern, you explore how far an aircraft can be pushed beyond natural stability, and what performance that buys. Instability makes aircraft more agile, but only if the control system can keep them flying. You own your project end to end: you choose and build unstable airframes, identify their dynamics from flight data, design the control that stabilizes them, and measure the limits of what can be achieved. You work on agile, high-performance platforms in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, flying frequently on a dedicated test range. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship.

Responsibilities
Select and justify unstable configurations to study, such as multirotor and VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), relaxed-stability fixed wings, and tailless, blended-wing or canard layouts.

  • Design and build the airframes yourself (foam, 3D printing, composites), integrate the avionics provided by the team, and repair after crashes.

  • Plan and run flight test campaigns with excitation maneuvers, and iterate quickly on a dedicated test range.

  • Identify the aircraft dynamics from flight data (system identification) and validate the models against analytical and simulated results.

  • Design and tune stabilizing controllers on PX4 or ArduPilot, then port them to Harmattan's in-house flight controller firmware.

  • Push the instability step by step, for example by moving the center of gravity aft or reducing control surfaces, and analyze stability margins.

  • Quantify the performance envelope, including the limits set by actuator bandwidth, sensor noise and latency, and the agility gained in return.

  • Build a reusable toolchain: a Python simulation workflow (for example JSBSim or Gazebo) validated on flight data, hardware-in-the-loop tests, flight test procedures and a data analysis pipeline.

You will own the full thermal and aerothermal engineering cycle for our UAV platforms: from early design recommendations and simulation to wind tunnel experiments and flight test campaigns. Your work directly impacts the survivability, reliability, and performance of our systems in contested environments. You will be the technical authority on heat transfer, thermal management, and aerothermal interactions across all vehicle programs — working closely with aerodynamics, propulsion, mechanical, and GNC teams to ensure our platforms perform within thermal limits under real operational conditions.

Responsibilities

  • Aerothermal Design & Recommendations: Provide early-stage design guidance on thermal management architecture — including cooling inlet design, heat shield placement, exhaust routing, and surface coatings — to ensure airframes remain within thermal limits across the full flight envelope.

  • Thermal & Aerothermal Simulation: Set up, run, and validate lower fidelity thermal models, simulations and coupled thermal-fluid CFD tools (e.g., OpenFOAM). Model convective, conductive, and radiative heat transfer on internal components (batteries, motors, avionics) and external aerodynamic surfaces.

  • Design Optimization: Drive iterative aerothermal optimization cycles to minimize thermal drag penalty, reduce hotspot intensity, and maximize cooling efficiency. Leverage scripting and automated workflows to sweep design parameters and converge on optimal configurations.

  • Wind Tunnel Test Campaigns: Design, plan, and execute aerothermal wind tunnel experiments. Define instrumentation strategy (thermocouples, heat flux sensors, pressure taps), write test plans, operate test rigs, and lead post-test data analysis and correlation with simulation.

  • Flight Test Campaigns: Contribute to and lead in-flight thermal measurement campaigns. Define DAQ architecture for thermal sensors, develop test matrices, analyze flight data, and correlate with CFD predictions to validate models and sign off thermal margins.

  • Cross-functional Integration: Act as the thermal interface between the aerodynamics, propulsion, mechanical, and GNC teams — ensuring that thermal constraints are reflected in system-level trade-offs and that heat rejection requirements are accounted for in the airframe design.

Requirements

  • Education: B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with a strong focus on fluid mechanics and heat transfer.

  • AeroThermal Fundamentals: Solid theoretical grounding in convective, conductive, and radiative heat transfer; boundary layer theory; and viscous flow physics as applied to aircraft surfaces and internal cooling passages.

  • Thermal Simulation Proficiency: Hands-on experience with CFD simulations in at least one major solver (OpenFOAM, Star-CCM+, ANSYS Fluent/CFX, or equivalent). Ability to select appropriate thermal boundary conditions, turbulence models, and mesh strategies for accuracy.

  • Experimental Testing: Demonstrated experience planning and executing thermal measurement campaigns — either in wind tunnel or in-flight — including instrumentation selection, DAQ setup, data reduction, and uncertainty analysis.

  • Python Proficiency: Ability to script data processing pipelines, automate post-processing of thermal simulation outputs, and interface with experimental DAQ systems.

  • Technical Communication: Ability to translate complex aerothermal findings into clear design recommendations for multidisciplinary teams.

Nice to have

  • General Aerodynamic Knowledge: Familiarity with the fundamentals of external aerodynamics — lift and drag generation, pressure distributions, boundary layer behaviour, and flow separation — as applied to fixed-wing or multirotor UAV platforms.

  • RC Knowledge: Hands-on experience building, flying, or tuning RC aircraft or drones — whether fixed-wing, quadcopter, or hybrid configurations.

Wij zijn op zoek naar een Senior Financial Controller voor Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen (UHT) in Utrecht. Business Control bestaat uit circa 25 tot 30 medewerkers, verdeeld over vijf clusterteams.

Als Senior Financial Controller ben je inhoudelijk deskundige op het gebied van financiële rapportages, analyses en Planning & Control. Vanuit Business Control werk je voor één of enkele clusters binnen UHT en fungeer je voornamelijk op tactisch niveau als sparringpartner voor de business. Je stelt nieuwe rapportages op, verbetert bestaande rapportages en bewaakt de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van financiële cijfers.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Opstellen, bespreken en verbeteren van financiële analyses en rapportages.

  • Uitvoeren van verbandscontroles om de betrouwbaarheid van financiële cijfers te waarborgen.

  • Adviseren van teamleiders en management over financiële ontwikkelingen en knelpunten.

  • Regie voeren op en uitvoering geven aan financiële rapportages uit de Planning & Control-cyclus.

  • Analyseren van financiële ontwikkelingen voor zowel apparaats- als programma-uitgaven.

  • Bijdragen aan budgetbrieven, waaronder input voor de Voorjaarsnota en Najaarsnota.

  • Bijdragen aan het opstellen en beheren van VT-aanvragen en uitvoering geven aan het financieel beheer van het cluster.

  • Inventariseren, afstemmen en implementeren van verbeteringen in bestaande rapportages.


Wat vragen wij?

Eisen:

  • Je beschikt over minimaal WO-werk- en denkniveau, aantoonbaar door een afgeronde universitaire opleiding (WO) in de richting van Finance of Bedrijfseconomie, óf je hebt minimaal 5 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring als Financial Controller of in een vergelijkbare functie.

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met de Planning & Control-cyclus, waaronder het opstellen en analyseren van financiële rapportages en het bewaken van de betrouwbaarheid van financiële cijfers.

  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring binnen het financiële vakgebied, gericht op het opstellen en analyseren van financiële verantwoordings- en stuurinformatie.

Aanvullende wensen:

  • Je hebt aantoonbare werkervaring met de Planning & Control-cyclus (PDCA), waaronder het opstellen, analyseren en bespreken van financiële rapportages.

  • Je hebt aantoonbare werkervaring met het ontwikkelen, opstellen en monitoren van KPI’s en het vertalen van de resultaten naar stuurinformatie.

What’s in it for you (to start with):

And many more benefits that you can read about at the bottom of the job description!


Your challenges:

The Creatives team works on and is responsible for our Image Editor and related image-processing features.
You will be working on the backend and sometimes a little bit on the frontend of a complex distributed web application. Our tool provides several different services, written in Haskell, Python, and Rust.

In this position, you will be responsible for the architecture, development, and maintenance of new and old image-related features in our application. An important aspect of our work is scaling our services to the next level, so we can handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput while keeping our app fast and responsive. To give you a sense of scale: a couple hundred millions of images are inspected, transformed and created by our services every day.

  • Plan and shape the future of the Creatives suite of features with our tight-knit team

  • Design, develop, and test new product features

  • Improve the reliability and robustness of our application

  • Work on scalability and performance improvements

  • Collaborate with our other product and platform teams to integrate image-manipulating features with other parts of our tool.

Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform.

Who are you?

  • You have good programming skills in Haskell (or a similar typed functional language)

Practical requirements:

Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.


The team:

You will join the Creatives team, consisting of five more Backend engineers, two Frontend engineers, a Product Manager, and a UI/UX designer. 

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. As our (Senior) Logistics Lead, you will own these logistics at Axelera end to end. You will lead the relationship with our global 3PL partner, from business reviews and KPI management to speaking up when something goes wrong. At the same time, you will stay hands-on: receiving, kitting and dispatching goods for our R&D, test and lab teams. Internal Logistics

Internal: Supply Chain and Planning, Sales and Customer Operations, Finance, R&D and test labs, Legal and Compliance

About Tebi

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to build and run the systems behind Tebi’s revenue engine, from how we find and win merchants to how we onboard, retain and grow them across seven European markets.

You’ll apply skills like building enrichment flows, tracking buying signals, setting up outbound and automating workflows in HubSpot and the tools around it across the customer lifecycle, from lead enrichment and outbound to onboarding handover, customer health and expansion. You’ll report to our RevOps Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Onboarding, Account Management and the Data team.

This is a hands-on role where speed matters. You’ll build with Clay, HubSpot, n8n, APIs, webhooks and AI, and take every idea from first experiment to a system the whole go-to-market team relies on. You understand what drives revenue, so you know what is worth building, and you work in short loops: ship fast, measure, learn and adapt quickly.

What You’ll Do

Build the acquisition engine

  • Build enrichment flows, ideal customer profile scoring and lead routing that turn raw leads into clear next actions for reps in HubSpot.

  • Design and automate signal tracking across the funnel, including walk-in activity in emerging markets not yet visible in HubSpot.

  • Build outbound plays and sequencing systems for sales-led and PLG motions, and run experiments to learn how best to reach customers.

  • Prototype and improve an AI outbound assistant that saves reps time, with a human in the loop.

Build the processes and automation behind onboarding, retention and expansion

  • Design and automate the Sales-to-Onboarding handover process across our toolstack, replacing manual steps and setting milestones, ownership and service levels from signed to live, with alerts when a merchant stalls.

  • Set up the retention signals and risk alerts that matter, each routed to a clear action and owner.

  • Design the expansion framework from scratch for sales-led (Account Manager-led) and PLG (automated, in-product or lifecycle) upsell, and build the plays, sequences and automation behind it in our toolstack.

  • Measure and refine these processes against pipeline, retention and expansion outcomes, and talk to reps, Account Managers and merchants about their pain points to turn what you learn into better workflows and systems.

  • Build and maintain the integrations across our toolstack, including HubSpot, BigQuery and the enrichment and outbound tools, and document system logic so it scales with the team.

What You’ll Need

  • Around 3 or more years of relevant experience in RevOps, sales operations or customer success operations, or an equivalent role in B2B SaaS.

  • Hands-on experience building enrichment flows, signal tracking and outbound systems.

  • Experience in high-velocity SaaS or an agency.

  • Good knowledge of Clay and other GTM tools, such as n8n, Make, Apollo, Instantly or similar, and comfort working with APIs and webhooks.

  • Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond admin work: workflows, lifecycle stages, properties and reporting.

  • Proven experience building workflows, sequences and lifecycle automation end to end, for both sales-led and PLG motions.

  • Experience designing and automating onboarding or handover processes, and defining health, risk and expansion signals that turn into alerts and actions.

  • The ability to understand customer pain points and translate them into plays and systems that people use in their daily work.

  • Day-to-day experience building with AI, with real workflows, agents or automations you have shipped, and a habit of testing new tools to see what works.

  • An “everything is figureoutable” mindset: you start from a blank page, ship a first version fast, learn from what happens and adapt quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with BigQuery, Dataform, Metabase or comparable analytics tools.

  • B2B SaaS experience in a growing company where systems and processes are still being built, ideally across multiple countries or markets.

  • Familiarity with hospitality technology, POS, payments or merchant services.

  • Experience applying AI to outbound and customer success workflows, with attention to data quality and human review.

We’re looking for an operator who thinks commercially, builds with AI every day and moves fast: building from scratch, learning by testing, and helping every merchant get live quickly and grow with us.

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch in the office

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

The role is based at our office in Amsterdam and involves regular international travel to customers, partners and sea trials.

This is a player-coach role. In the first months you are hands-on in our most important opportunities: running technical discovery with navies, coast guards, port authorities and system integrators, translating operational requirements (from harbour protection to seabed and subsea infrastructure surveillance) into system architectures, leading demonstrations and sea trials, and being the technical counterpart the customer trusts.

In parallel you lay the foundations: a clear engagement model with Sales and Bid Management, a repeatable technical sales process and reusable solution and demo assets. Within 12 months you have hired and developed a team of solution architects across our key regions, and your focus has shifted from doing the work to multiplying it.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the technical win on priority opportunities: lead discovery, solution design, demonstrations and sea trials together with the responsible Sales Director.

  • Build the pre-sales function: define the structure and role profiles, and recruit, onboard and develop solution architects aligned with our regional sales structure.

  • Design the engagement model with Sales and Bid Management, from qualification to technical win and hand-over to project delivery.

  • Develop scalable assets, such as reference architectures, demo set-ups, technical tender content and a knowledge base, so new engineers are productive in weeks, not months.

  • Define and report pre-sales metrics such as coverage, technical win rate and trial conversion in our CRM, and translate customer requirements into input for Product Management and R&D.

  • Collaborate with Sales Directors, Bid Management, Product Management and R&D to win and deliver complex, multi-year naval and underwater security programmes.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of our technical sales processes, tools and automation.

What we offer:

  • Join one of Europe's fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success.

  • A great team in an international organisation with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

  • A competitive salary and benefits package.

  • 30 days of holiday per year.

  • Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events.


Requirements:

  • Master's degree in Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Photonics or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in pre-sales, solutions, application or systems engineering for complex technical systems, including 3+ years leading or building a customer-facing technical team in a fast-growing environment.

  • A broad technical engineering background and proven experience in long-cycle, complex B2B or B2G sales, translating customer requirements into technical solutions.

  • Willingness to travel internationally, including to customer sites and sea trials.

  • Excellent command of English, written and spoken.

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, hands-on mindset.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of underwater acoustic sensing, sonar and signal processing; domain knowledge can be developed on the job.

  • Experience with tender-driven sales to navies or other defence and security customers.

  • Experience in fiber optic sensing, anti-submarine warfare, seabed surveillance or protection of critical undersea infrastructure such as cables and pipelines.

  • Experience with export control regimes (EU dual-use, ITAR) and defence procurement requirements such as industrial participation.

  • Knowledge of Dutch, German, French or another European language.

As you will be working with clients in the defence and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

Jij bent iemand die graag ergens induikt, zaken tot op de bodem uitzoekt en complexe informatie weet te vertalen naar praktische oplossingen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en krijgt energie van een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast:

Bij Zwart krijg je niet alleen een interessante HR-functie, maar ook de kans om daadwerkelijk iets op te bouwen. Onze internationale groei brengt nieuwe uitdagingen met zich mee en jij krijgt de ruimte om hier vanuit jouw expertise mede vorm aan te geven.

data.description:
Build with us

Businesses deserve better from finance. Less friction, more freedom. Since 2004, Mollie has been on a mission to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies trust our all-in-one platform to get paid, manage money and grow on their terms. Simple, scalable and built with real businesses in mind.

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs, with 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations. Our people make this growth possible. We move fast, build with purpose and care deeply about our customers. Whether you're solving problems, building market-leading products or exploring how AI can make work smarter, you'll have the freedom to create and the trust to deliver.

If you're ready to grow, shape the future of fintech and join an ambitious, high-performing team, this is the place for you.

Your impact

As a Senior Business Development Representative, you'll play a key role in accelerating Mollie's growth in the Netherlands, building relationships with larger SMB merchants and helping them find the right payment solutions for their businesses.

You'll take full commercial ownership of your pipeline, combining inbound and outbound sales and managing more complex opportunities with businesses with annual revenue of up to €12M.

Joining an established, high-performing Dutch sales team, you'll bring your commercial expertise, market understanding and independent approach to winning new business, while continuing to grow your expertise in payments and fintech.

What you'll ship

  • Generate new business through a roughly 50/50 mix of inbound and outbound sales activities.

  • Independently own the full sales cycle, managing larger and more complex commercial opportunities.

  • Lead consultative sales conversations, understand merchant needs and position the right payment solutions.

  • Consistently achieve quarterly sales targets and drive net revenue growth in the Netherlands.

  • Navigate complex negotiations and stakeholder relationships to convert opportunities into live merchants.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful merchant onboarding, implementation and go-live.

  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, manage a healthy pipeline and actively share your commercial knowledge with the team.

What you will bring

  • Ideally 3+ years of B2B technology sales experience, or at least 2 years of highly relevant experience in payments or fintech.

  • A proven track record of achieving sales targets and independently generating new business through outbound prospecting, including cold calling.

  • Strong full-cycle sales experience, with the ability to independently manage larger customers and more complex deals.

  • Well-developed consultative selling, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong market understanding, commercial judgement, pipeline management and forecasting skills.

  • Native-level Dutch.

  • Curiosity about technology and the practical application of AI in sales.

  • A hungry, humble and smart mindset. You're ambitious, hands-on, self-aware and confident in taking ownership, while remaining open to feedback and continuous learning.

Experience in fintech, payments or the payment service provider (PSP) ecosystem is a strong advantage, but not a requirement.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

 

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

 

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

Do you thrive on complex problems and want to work at the forefront of AI? Join Cefetra Group’s new AI Innovation Hub as an AI Engineer and shape how AI creates value across our international trading business, from agents and workflows integrated with our core systems to the skills and ways of working that make them stick.

Who we are

Cefetra Group comprises several trading companies in the agricultural sector and the food ingredients industry, with leading brands in the ingredients market. Together, we employ approximately 800 people across 39 offices in 17 countries worldwide. We work closely together to provide our customers with the best possible service. Together with our suppliers, we develop strong supply chains and create value by sourcing raw materials and supplying them to the international food, animal feed and energy industries. Behind that sits real complexity: global commodity flows, volatile markets, intricate contracts and logistics, and data spread across many entities and systems. That is exactly where AI can make a decisive difference, and we are building the capability to make it happen.

The role

As an AI Engineer in the AI Innovation Hub, part of the Group Digital & Technology team, your goal is to build Cefetra Group’s AI capability and set the standard for how AI is designed and used across our entities. You’ll deliver AI solutions, from agents and workflows to knowledge bases, that teams across Cefetra Group can apply to augment their work, while helping colleagues build the skills to use them. You’ll work directly with process owners and business leaders to find where AI creates the most value. The AI Innovation Hub is just getting started, so together with the Group Digital & Technology team you’ll shape its direction from the ground up: which opportunities it pursues and how it delivers them. You’ll also work with Builders and Changemakers, colleagues in our entities who build AI solutions and drive adoption, to share what works and show business leaders what AI makes possible.

Your responsibilities include

  • Run discovery workshops to identify bottlenecks, value and exceptions. Assess use cases against readiness, team commitment, expected value and reuse potential.

  • Build AI workflows and agents using company data. Take prototypes all the way to robust, production-grade solutions that teams rely on in their daily work.

  • Integrate AI solutions with ERP, finance and operations systems, designing integrations that move safely from read-only access to controlled write-back.

  • Test solutions against real business scenarios. Set the deployment patterns, tool choices and safeguards that others across Cefetra Group build on.

  • Deliver hands-on workshops, from practical AI topics such as Claude Skills for non-technical colleagues to technical topics such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Builders and create materials Changemakers can use to train their peers.

  • Prepare demos of working use cases for leadership briefings.

Who you are

To succeed at Cefetra Group, you love complexity and combine deep technical curiosity with a pragmatic, collaborative approach. You work well both independently and with people at all levels of Cefetra Group. You take ownership end to end and move easily between governance, technical details and business priorities. You also meet the following requirements:

  • You have at least four years of experience in a technical, customer-facing, consulting or product role.

  • You’ve built and evaluated large language model (LLM) workflows, agents or applications in production.

  • You have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, indexing, knowledge bases, context engineering and orchestration.

  • You follow AI developments closely, from new models to agentic patterns and protocols, and know how to turn new capabilities into practical value.

  • You have full-stack development experience with Python or TypeScript, including APIs, authentication, data transformation and enterprise integrations.

  • You’re fluent in English and have led workshops for non-technical audiences.

What we offer

A unique opportunity to help Cefetra Group grow and become part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial team within an established multinational. We’re always open to discussing your individual needs. Here’s what we offer.

  • Access to frontier AI models and the room to experiment with new tools, techniques and ways of working.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working, as well as opportunities to learn and develop.

  • An excellent remuneration and benefits package, including a competitive base salary, holiday allowance, an attractive bonus scheme and 28 days of annual leave.

  • An office in one of the finest locations in central Rotterdam, overlooking the Maas and the Erasmus Bridge, with plenty of social activities and excellent coffee.
